q.v: Für das Beschädigen oder Abnehmen der Plakate nehmt ihr am besten einen langen Besen mit, mit dessen Kopf ihr am oberen Ende des Plakates ansetzen und es so den Laternenpfahl herunterziehen könnt. Außerdem braucht ihr eine Zange, um die Kabelbinder zu zerschneiden. Cuttermesser können ebenfalls effektiv eingesetzt werden.
q.e: For damaging or taking down the posters, it is best to take a long broom, position its head at the upper edge of the poster, and pull it down the lamppost. You also need pliers to cut the cable ties. Utility knives can also be used effectively.

q.v: Für das Bemalen eignen sich bei Wahlplakaten am besten Sprühdosen, aber breite Marker tun es zur Not auch. Wer richtig Bock hat, kann eine Sprühverlängerung bauen (siehe unten) oder Drucksprüher benutzen.
q.e: For painting election posters, spray cans are best, but broad markers will also do in a pinch. Anyone who is really keen can build a spray extension (see below) or use pressure sprayers.

q.v: Man könnte z.B. eine spitze Nagelschere oder ein spitzes, kleines Messer in einem Stoffbeutel verbergen, und beim Schuhebinden mit einer beiläufigen Bewegung ein Loch in den Reifen stechen.
q.e: For example, one could conceal pointed nail scissors or a small pointed knife in a cloth bag and, while tying one's shoes, puncture the tire with a casual movement.

q.v: Solltest du vorhaben etwas zu werfen etc., dann achte unbedingt darauf dafür ein extra paar DNA-freie Handschuhe zu verwenden (s iehe 🧬 Spuren).

q.v: Die Person fährt mit einem Schild auf den steht „Ich fahre ohne Ticket“. Denn der Paragraph heißt „Erschleichen von Leistungen“. Was wird denn hier erschlichen wenn man offen sagt, dass man kein Ticket hat.
q.e: The person travels with a sign that says, “I travel without a ticket.” Because the provision is called “obtaining services by deception.” What is being obtained by deception here if one openly says that one has no ticket?

q.v: Simple wheatpaste recipe: 4 cups water 1 cup flour Mix water and flour thoroughly in pot with a whisk until smooth. Put over medium high heat and whisk frequently until a yogurt or gravy like consistency is achieved (paste will thicken when cooled).

Once cooled, transfer to a container of your choice. Consider squeeze bottles, or wide-necked jars. Apply liberally to surface using a brush or roller. Smoother surfaces such as glass, metal work best. Concrete or brick is good too. Apply poster, then apply another layer of wheatpaste.

q.v: L’unica via d’uscita dall’incubo delle guerre capitaliste e della pace capitalista è un risveglio collettivo: dobbiamo vedere e sabotare l’intera macchina della guerra, rovesciare i suoi rappresentanti e reclamare il nostro potere di creatori del mondo.
q.e: The only way out of the nightmare of capitalist wars and capitalist peace is a collective awakening: we must see and sabotage the entire war machine, overthrow its representatives, and reclaim our power as creators of the world.

q.v: On the contrary, turning arms against officers and managers of war is a part of the same struggle as desertion.
we will defend our political space with all the means at our disposal.

q.v: Aktionen, über die ihr vorher reden solltet, um euch aufeinander verlassen zu können: Durchbrechen, Pyro, Gefangenenbefreiung (Schubsen, Ziehen, Schlagen – ihr braucht dafür mehrere Menschen, denen ihr vertraut), Barrikaden, Sachbeschädigung, Werfen.
q.e: Actions you should discuss beforehand so that you can rely on one another: breaking through, pyrotechnics, prisoner liberation (pushing, pulling, hitting—you need several people you trust for this), barricades, property damage, throwing.

q.v: Geht am besten in einem normalen bunten Outfit zur Demo, um Vorkontrollen zu vermeiden. T-Shirt, Schals, FFP2 Masken und Handschuhe sind nicht strafbar, im Gegensatz zu Schlauchschals und Sturmhauben. Nehmt am besten 2 Vermummungen, falls ihr mit einer gefilmt werdet.
q.e: It is best to go to the demonstration in a normal, colorful outfit in order to avoid pre-checks. T-shirts, scarves, FFP2 masks, and gloves are not punishable, unlike tube scarves and balaclavas. It is best to take two face coverings in case you are filmed wearing one.

q.v: Fünf Finger Rabatt, Kauf-keins-krieg-eins-gratis oder einfach Ladendiebstahl. Es hat viele Namen, aber eines ändert sich nicht: es isteine Möglichkeit den Griff des Kapitalismus auf uns ein wenig zu lockern.
q.e: Five-finger discount, buy-none-get-one-free, or simply shoplifting. It has many names, but one thing does not change: it is a way to loosen capitalism's grip on us a little.

q.v: Unser Tipp: Nehmt schwarze Klamotten und Vermummung mit und zieht euch erst im Ernstfall um. Durch den Schutz von Bannern kann man sich schnell mal ducken, um eine Jacke über zu ziehen und sich zu vermummen. Das macht auch eine Nachverfolgung im Ernstfall schwerer.
q.e: Our tip: Take black clothes and face coverings with you and only change in an emergency. Under the cover of banners, you can quickly duck down to put on a jacket and cover your face. That also makes tracking more difficult in an emergency.

q.v: Also ganz wichtig: Tiiiiief durchatmen und niemals mit staatlichen Behörden kommunizieren. Es ist immer unangenehm, aber euch kann nichts passieren wenn ihr nichts sagt! Der VS hat *keine* polizeilichen Befugnisse o.Ä., schickt sie einfach weg oder schließt die Tür.
q.e: Most importantly: take a deeeeep breath and never communicate with state authorities. It is always unpleasant, but nothing can happen to you if you say nothing! The domestic intelligence service has *no* police powers or anything similar; simply send them away or close the door.

q.v: La planificación que realizaba Chechin, siempre conllevaba planos de la situación operativa, planos generales preparación física de los combatientes, logística e incluso maquetas y lo más importante, asumir el mando de la operación y estar en la primera línea del combate, sabía que en los detalles estaba la diferencia.
q.e: The planning Chechin carried out always included plans of the operational situation, general plans, physical preparation of the combatants, logistics, and even models; and most importantly, taking command of the operation and being on the front line of combat—he knew that the difference was in the details.

q.v: Las barricadas, el enfrentamiento con las fuerzas represivas, el ataque a las grandes cadenas de supermercados, bancos y demás instituciones del gran capital, por parte de un pueblo rebelde así como también las multitudinarias marchas, el arte popular, la solidaridad entre vecinos, la ayuda entre todos y todas son situaciones que jamás podremos olvidar.
q.e: The barricades, the confrontation with the repressive forces, the attack on large supermarket chains, banks, and other institutions of big capital by a rebellious people—as well as the massive marches, popular art, solidarity among neighbors, and mutual aid—are situations we will never be able to forget.

q.e: The unexpected and joyful blockade is a tool of provocation. It is a means of sabotaging the gears of a social mechanism that wants us to be indifferent to the world around us and insensitive to our inner passions.

q.e: Let all those responsible for the vile act (from the Magnificent [Rector] downward, no one excluded) know that what happened will add more fuel to our fire and, consequently, more determination to make their life within the University a hell.

q.e: Carrying out—whether they know it or not—a sabotage of the reproduction of the economy and of the circulation of the monotonous march of human commodities.

q.v: Existe algo como “violencia proletaria de masas difusa”, que se coordina de manera solidaria en medio de las barricadas, que hace innecesaria –al menos, por ahora- cualquier tipo de especialización o profesionalización de esta actividad por grupúsculos. Hasta el momento, esto ha sido bastante efectivo.

q.v: Wir wollen unsere Ziele nicht nur als Forderungen auf die Straße tragen, sondern sie auch in direkten Aktionen umsetzen. Deshalb hatten wir ein Haus in der [STREET ADDRESS in Bonn] besetzt.
q.e: We do not want merely to take our goals to the streets as demands, but also to put them into practice through direct actions. That is why we occupied a house at [STREET ADDRESS in Bonn].

q.v: Insofern ist die Aneignung von Freiraum wünschenswert, erforderlich, geradezu nötig.
q.e: In this respect, the appropriation of free space is desirable, necessary—indeed, urgently necessary.

q.v: Wir halten nach wie vor daran fest das gezielte Stiche gegen die Eigentumslogik wichtiger Bestandteil unserer Arbeit sein muss und Hausbesetzungen dazu ein wunderbares Mittel sind.
q.e: We continue to maintain that targeted jabs at the logic of property must be an important component of our work, and that squatting is a wonderful means to that end.

q.v: So könnte z.B. eine Besetzung, für einen Raum in dem Geflüchteten-Selbstorganisation ermöglicht wird, eine Option schaffen einerseits sich einen Teil der Stadt zu nehmen, andererseits eine bitter nötige Anlaufstelle für Geflüchtete zu schaffen, in der das Repressionsrisiko verringert ist.
q.e: For example, an occupation of a space in which refugee self-organization is enabled could create an option, on the one hand, to take a part of the city for ourselves and, on the other, to create a desperately needed point of contact for refugees where the risk of repression is reduced.

q.v: Je na čase náš boj přitvrdit, tak aby náš hněv skutečně pocítili. Naše práce je to, co vytváří jejich zisky a právě její zastavení může tvorbu zisků a moci narušit. Přejít k časově neomezené generální stávce tedy pro nás může být strategicky výhodné.
q.e: It is time to intensify our struggle so that they truly feel our anger. Our work is what creates their profits, and stopping it can disrupt the creation of profits and power. Moving to an open-ended general strike can therefore be strategically advantageous for us.

q.v: Taková normalita se nám hnusí a sabotáž volební propagandy je prostředek, jak jí podrývat!
q.e: This kind of normality disgusts us, and sabotaging electoral propaganda is a means of undermining it!

q.v: Jistě, nebojme se vlamovat na soukromé pozemky a vůbec, nestyďme se konat ještě radikálněji!
q.e: Certainly, let us not be afraid to break into private premises, and generally, let us not be ashamed to act even more radically!

q.v: Když ale útočíme individuálně či afinitně se soudruhy tam, kde můžeme ublížit citelněji, tak máme jedině tak naprostou kontrolu nad svými životy a jsme schopni žít s radostí a klidem, že děláme naši revoluci.
q.e: But when we attack individually or with comrades in affinity groups, where we can cause more palpable harm, only in this way do we have complete control over our lives and can live with the joy and peace of mind that we are making our revolution.

q.v: Budou následovat další akty vzpoury, v nichž blokujeme, poškozujeme nebo ničíme nástroje útlaku a vykořisťování.
q.e: Further acts of revolt will follow, in which we block, damage, or destroy the instruments of oppression and exploitation.

q.v: Alle diese Verteilerkästen, diese Schienenweichen, diese Signalmasten, diese omnipräsenten Kabelstränge neben den Schienen in dünnen Kanälen, der Gnade der Vernachlässigung und Wut ausgeliefert, machen die Möglichkeit, dass etwas passieren wird, beinah zur Gewissheit.
q.e: All these distribution boxes, these track switches, these signal masts, these omnipresent bundles of cables beside the tracks in thin conduits, left at the mercy of neglect and anger, make the possibility that something will happen almost a certainty.

q.v: Wir entschieden Krieg zu führen gegen jene, welche die Erde zerstören, uns zerstören. Angriff, Brand, Sabotage, Sachbeschädigung, Enteignung, nicht aufgeben…wir alle haben Fähigkeiten, trage deine dazu bei.
q.e: We decided to wage war against those who destroy the Earth, who destroy us. Attack, arson, sabotage, property damage, expropriation—do not give up… we all have abilities; contribute yours.

q.v: Caminaron por zonas oscuras del recinto de prision, eludieron los sistemas de alarma y se aprendieron en qué momento la garita con la puerta corredera de entrada de coches que tenían que forzar para salir estaba vacía, ya que el carcelero tenía otra función en el momento en el que ellos pasaban por allí.
q.e: They walked through dark areas of the prison compound, evaded the alarm systems, and learned at what time the guard post with the sliding vehicle-entry gate that they had to force open to get out was empty, since the prison guard had another task at the time they passed through there.

q.v: Que ce soit par l’internationalisme en soutenant les déserteurs et en faisant tomber les frontières dans les combats pour la liberté, le sabotage de l’union nationale en soutenant les révoltes sociales ou la visibilisation et l’attaque directe des rouages de la guerre partout où ils existent.
q.e: Whether through internationalism by supporting deserters and bringing down borders in struggles for freedom, sabotaging national unity by supporting social revolts, or making visible and directly attacking the mechanisms of war wherever they exist.

q.v: nous sommes convaincu qu’un acte aussi juste – et vécu comme telle par une importante partie de la population – et réalisé de telle manière à être bien compris pour ce qu’il est, trouve des échos et provoquera des répercussions indélébiles.
q.e: We are convinced that such a just act—experienced as such by a significant part of the population—and carried out in such a way as to be clearly understood for what it is, will find resonance and provoke indelible repercussions.

q.v: Face au terrorisme d’Etat, qui lui est nécessaire pour intimider durablement et contenir toutes velléités de rébellion contre son ordre abject, il n’y a pas d’en-dehors et l’action directe décentralisée et imprévisible reste un bon moyen pour relancer les hostilités ou appuyer les révoltes à l’intérieur.
q.e: Faced with state terrorism, which it needs in order to durably intimidate and contain any inclination toward rebellion against its abject order, there is no outside, and decentralized and unpredictable direct action remains a good way to reignite hostilities or support revolts inside.

q.v: Only people in Belarus, by armed uprising, can destroy the dictatorship.
We’ve managed to disassemble the rail joint and unscrewed the nuts attaching rail to sleepers. As it happens, all it takes is a standard construction tools, adjustable wrenches with a handle > 0,5 m.

What was done: 34 nuts of the rails were unscrewed; 4 nuts, connecting rail joint; Rail in the place of joint was raised up, put to the connecting plate (to prevent its return to its place) and moved aside;
For detonation we’ve used the ignition device made of a lamp bulb. There was a backup initiator with an alarm clock on a mobile phone, but the ignition itself was conducted with a phone call.
Lukashenka’s regime trade with his accomplices from other countries needs to be blocked by radical direct action. Therefore, we will continue to attack.

q.v: Если ваша аффинити-группа участвует в массовых мероприятиях (митинги, протесты, фестивали) придумайте себе псевдонимы — это повысит вашу безопасность в случае задержания людей, которые присутствовали при вашем общении.
q.e: If your affinity group participates in mass events (rallies, protests, festivals), come up with pseudonyms for yourselves—this will increase your security if people who were present during your communication are detained.

q.v: Не рассказывайте никому об акциях, в которых участвовали. Не проводите агитрейды и тем более акции прямого действия в районе проживания. Тщательно закрывайте лица — помните, что в больших городах камеры повсюду. Не берите на серьёзные акции телефоны.
q.e: Do not tell anyone about actions in which you participated. Do not conduct agitation raids, much less direct actions, in the area where you live. Cover your faces carefully—remember that cameras are everywhere in big cities. Do not take phones to serious actions.

q.v: Нужно действовать вдвоём. Расклейку безопаснее и удобнее делать вдвоём.
q.e: It is necessary to act in pairs. Putting up leaflets is safer and more convenient to do in pairs.

q.v: Самое первое правило: не печатайте политические листовки в копицентрах, фотосалонах, коммерческих типографиях и других местах, где печатью занимается сторонний человек.
q.e: The very first rule: do not print political leaflets at copy centers, photo shops, commercial print shops, or other places where printing is handled by another person.

q.v: Важно всё чистить
q.e: It is important to clear/delete everything.

q.v: A project whose path has already been studded by direct actions against those who collaborate, both public institutions and private enterprises.

From paint to stones, from hammers to flames, from destruction to sabotage, it’s a constellation of attacks that completely breaks away from the penal code, political strategy or complacency with the State.

blogs.sum: French radical film collective emerging from the Gilets Jaunes movement. q.v: nous avons reçu de nombreuses contributions venues de plusieurs villes de France ainsi qu’un appel des B.A.C à saboter un concours étudiant aux consignes absurdes sur le thème de la révolution.
q.e: we received numerous contributions from several cities in France, as well as a call from the B.A.C. to sabotage a student competition with absurd rules on the theme of revolution.

blogs.sum: French-language anarchist/individualist radical blog. A newer post appears to test site/forum functionality and list internal meeting dates, suggesting a small collective or project rather than a purely personal diary.

q.v: On est avec un brouilleur d’ondes et on arrache les détecteurs qui sont aussi des caméras et qui sont partout, au-dessus de chaque porte.
q.e: We have a signal jammer, and we tear off the detectors—which are also cameras—and which are everywhere, above every door.

q.v: On fait plein de visites la nuit ou l’on doit scier les imposantes plaques de métal qu’on trouve à chaque escalier.
q.e: We make lots of visits at night where we have to saw through the imposing metal plates found at every staircase.

blogs.sum: Italian autonomous social-centre/collective blog based in Monza. It publishes local anti-fascist memory initiatives, anti-racist sports events, prisoner/legal-solidarity benefits, self-managed public cinema and music events, and mobilizations against war production, including a protest at a named local military-supply manufacturer.

q.v: di fronte a tutto questo una scritta su un muro o qualunque altra azione che accenda i riflettori sul tema è il minimo che si possa fare.
q.e: In the face of all this, a writing on a wall or any other action that shines a spotlight on the issue is the least that can be done.

q.v: Disfattismo ovvero sabotaggio attivo della guerra nel proprio paese, rifiuto di arruolarsi nei ranghi diffondendo idee che spingono alla diserzione e alla guerra di classe, per fare della guerra dei padroni una guerra degli sfruttati.
q.e: Defeatism, that is, active sabotage of the war in one’s own country; refusal to enlist in the ranks by spreading ideas that encourage desertion and class war, in order to turn the masters’ war into a war of the exploited.

q.v: Capire come si articola l’economia e la logistica di guerra all’interno dei propri territori e individuarne i punti nevralgici, e per questo attaccabili, continua a essere un sentiero politico fondamentale da seguire insieme.
q.e: Understanding how the economy and logistics of war are structured within one’s own territories and identifying their key points—and therefore points that can be attacked—continues to be a fundamental political path to pursue together.

q.v: DISERTA la propaganda bellica! SABOTA la guerra e chi la produce! RESISTI contro l’imperialismo!
q.e: DESERT war propaganda! SABOTAGE the war and those who produce it! RESIST against imperialism!

q.v: immaginando come dare concretezza agli slogan che hanno animato questi tre giorni, per sabotare logistica ed economia di guerra, disertare la propaganda militarista, resistere contro il Governo Meloni e le sue politiche repressive.
q.e: imagining how to give concrete form to the slogans that animated these three days, to sabotage war logistics and the war economy, desert militarist propaganda, resist against the Meloni Government and its repressive policies.

q.v: С заботой о вашей безопасности, в равноправном диалоге, через обучение необходимым приёмам конспирации, если вы с ними не знакомы, мы найдём способы и методы быть активными.
q.e: With concern for your safety, through an equal dialogue and training in the necessary clandestine-security techniques, if you are not familiar with them, we will find ways and methods to be active.

q.v: Это одновременно революционный анализ современного состояния системы и вдохновляющий призыв продолжать сражаться, не боясь перейти к вооружённому действию.
q.e: This is both a revolutionary analysis of the current state of the system and an inspiring call to continue fighting, without being afraid to move to armed action.

q.v: Мы всегда рады поделиться знаниями по конспирации, интернет-безопасности и практическим методам осуществления атак.
q.e: We are always glad to share knowledge about clandestinity, internet security, and practical methods for carrying out attacks.

q.v: Enquanto direita e esquerda lutam pelo monopólio da violência, façamos da violência uma arma contra quem pretende nos governar…
q.e: While the right and left fight for the monopoly of violence, let us make violence a weapon against those who intend to govern us…

q.v: Contudo, esta atividade foi mais um impulso para que sigamos afiando nossas facas para apontar contra o poder…

q.v: O dia 4 de agosto, quinta feira, às 8 da manhã, vamos estar aqui, preparadxs para o confronto. Não vamos deixar a biblioteca antes desse dia. Vamos defender a Kaos, nosso espaço de expansão da anarquia. Convidamos a todxs que lutam contra a dominação, e se sentem afins pra lutar e dar uma força ao espaço, a nos apoiar com sua presença desde a rua.
q.e: On Thursday, August 4, at 8 in the morning, we will be here, prepared for confrontation. We will not leave the library before that day. We will defend Kaos, our space for the expansion of anarchy. We invite everyone who fights against domination and feels sympathetic to the struggle and to supporting the space to support us with their presence in the street.

q.v: Acreditamos que a tradução não se faz somente num aspecto “literal”, mas também, na capacidade de tornar entendível e “possível” experiências de luta armada anarquista neste território.
q.e: We believe that translation is not carried out only in a “literal” aspect, but also in its capacity to make experiences of anarchist armed struggle in this territory understandable and “possible.”

q.v: Wann werden wir endlich begreifen, dass es nicht darum geht, für unsere „Rechte” zu kämpfen, sondern darum, unsere lebenswichtigen Bedürfnisse direkt und ohne die Vermittlung von Geld zu befriedigen, und dass der Markt (kein Unternehmen, auch wenn es „selbstverwaltet” ist) und der Staat (keine Regierung, auch wenn sie „volksnah” ist) dies niemals wirklich tun werden, sondern nur wir selbst, die wir mit unserer Arbeit alles produziert haben, aber nichts besitzen, indem wir die Produktions- und Vertriebsmittel an uns nehmen (zum Beispiel durch Enteignung und Vergemeinschaftung der Unternehmen der Noboa-Gruppe…
q.e: When will we finally understand that it is not about fighting for our “rights,” but about directly satisfying our vital needs without the mediation of money, and that the market (no enterprise, even if it is “self-managed”) and the state (no government, even if it is “close to the people”) will never truly do this, but only we ourselves, who have produced everything with our labor but possess nothing, by taking possession of the means of production and distribution (for example through expropriation and collectivization of the companies of the Noboa Group…

q.v: Sie niederzubrennen ist kein Angriff auf den Glauben, sondern ein Angriff auf die Autorität.

q.v: Diejenigen, die auf die Straße gegangen sind, sind keine Opfer der Polizeigewalt, die eine ständige und gnadenlose Realität ist, sondern haben mutig beschlossen, sich dieser Gewalt zu stellen, sich darauf vorzubereiten und sie so weit wie möglich zurückzugeben.
q.e: Those who took to the streets are not victims of police violence, which is a constant and merciless reality, but rather courageously decided to confront this violence, prepare for it, and return it as far as possible.

q.v: Etwas ganz anderes ist es, aus nächster Nähe mitzuerleben, wie sich die Polizei in ungeordneter Flucht zurückzieht, wie eine Menschenmenge die Baustellenabsperrungen stürmt und überwindet, wie sich die Euphorie unter allen Anwesenden ausbreitet
q.e: It is quite another thing to experience at close range how the police retreat in disordered flight, how a crowd storms and overcomes the construction-site barriers, how euphoria spreads among everyone present.

q.v: Die wenigen Bilder dieses Tages haben alle gesehen: eine Rauchsäule, die aus einem brennenden Kleintransporter aufsteigt, pyrotechnische Effekte, ein Regen aus Steinen, die Baustelle in Trümmern.

q.v: Často chybí informace o jejich bydlišti, pohybu, zvycích, vztazích, citlivých místech jejich životů – tedy to, co nám může posloužit k boji proti jejich teroristickému jednání. Je v zájmu nejen nás anarchistů a anarchistek, abychom takové informace zjišťovali, sdíleli a využívali ve prospěch naší strategie v probíhajícím boji proti terorismu.
q.e: Information about their residences, movements, habits, relationships, and sensitive points in their lives is often missing—meaning that which can serve us in the struggle against their terrorist conduct. It is in the interest not only of us anarchists that we find out, share, and use such information for the benefit of our strategy in the ongoing struggle against terrorism.

q.v: Člověk si v první řadě musí ujasnit pro jaké účely zbraň chce mít. To usnadní volbu jakou si pořídit. Ale tato volba je jen začátek. Následovat by měly neméně důležité kroky jako je péče o zbraň a u mnohých i trénink.
q.e: First of all, a person must clarify for what purposes they want to have a weapon. That makes the choice of which one to acquire easier. But that choice is only the beginning. No less important steps should follow, such as caring for the weapon and, for many, training.

q.v: Chybí zde tedy informace týkající se ofenzivního využití zbraní třeba pro gerilový boj, sabotáže nebo expropriace. S trochou šikovnosti si ale jistě anarchisté a anarchistky najdou jiné zdroje takových informací.
q.e: It therefore lacks information concerning the offensive use of weapons, for example for guerrilla warfare, sabotage, or expropriations. But with a little skill, anarchists will surely find other sources of such information.

q.v: Ako ste me vidjeli. Nije bitno tko, gdje i kada. Pravite se da me niste vidjeli i nemojte ni čak pričati o tome. Ikada! Ako pričate s nekim tko kaže da me vidio, pokušajte ga uvjeriti da ne priča o tome. Ali, nemojte to činiti putem telefona ili interneta.
q.e: If you saw me, it does not matter who, where, or when. Pretend that you did not see me and do not even talk about it. Ever! If you speak with someone who says they saw me, try to convince them not to talk about it. But do not do so by phone or internet.

q.e: On Tuesday, December 31, on the eve of a new year, at around 2:30, a few minutes before the place closed, a time-delay incendiary mechanism was placed in the aisle of flammable products at the Homecenter located in the Plaza Norte shopping center.

q.v: Je le dis comme ça en toute clarté, afin que ceux qui font fasse à la répression sachent que le jour même où ça se passe il faut attaquer, et le suivant, et celui d’après, pour qu’il soit clair que les détenus ne sont pas les responsables
q.e: I say it this clearly, so that those facing repression know that on the very day it happens they must attack, and the next day, and the day after that, so that it is clear that the detainees are not the ones responsible.

q.v: Nous nous positionnons en tant qu’ennemis déclarés de toute forme d’autorité, prêts à nous organiser afin de fabriquer des cocktails Molotov, dresser des barricades et attaquer la police
q.e: We position ourselves as declared enemies of every form of authority, ready to organize ourselves in order to make Molotov cocktails, erect barricades, and attack the police.

q.v: Ci piace ricordare che il 20 settembre gran parte del CIE di Lampedusa è andato in fiamme, mentre i reclusi gridavano Libertà, causando serie difficoltà alla macchina delle espulsioni del ministro Maroni
q.e: We like to remember that on 20 September much of the Lampedusa CIE went up in flames, while the detainees shouted “Freedom,” causing serious difficulties for Minister Maroni’s deportation machinery.

q.v: PER FERMARE LA GUERRA OCCORRE METTERSI IN MEZZO NON BASTANO LE PAROLE, E’ NECESSARIA L’AZIONE TROVARE I PUNTI DEBOLI DELLA MACCHINA GUERRAFONDAIA, E SABOTARLI E’ NOSTRO COMPITO
q.e: To stop the war, we must put ourselves in the way; words are not enough, action is necessary. Finding the weak points of the warmongering machine and sabotaging them is our task.

q.v: E’ molto più efficace smontare, o distruggere, la base. Telecamere, polizia, militari, carceri, manicomi, CIE, frontiere, chiese, fabbriche, mass media, scuole sono solo alcune delle appendici che sorreggono lo stato e il capitale.
q.e: It is much more effective to dismantle, or destroy, the base. Cameras, police, military, prisons, psychiatric institutions, CIEs, borders, churches, factories, mass media, schools are only some of the appendages that support the state and capital.

q.v: Occupare case, creare Libere Repubbliche come in Val Susa, bloccare le vie di comunicazione, gli scioperi selvaggi o i sabotaggi sono altre forme di azioni diretta che di questi tempi possono far male davvero a chi pretende di governarci.
q.e: Occupying houses, creating Free Republics like in Val Susa, blocking communication routes, wildcat strikes, or sabotage are other forms of direct action which, these days, can really hurt those who claim to govern us.

q.v: Por último, hay que denunciar. Pedimos a asociaciones, abogadas o gente con experiencia y medios que denuncien esta situación.
q.e: Finally, a complaint must be filed. We ask associations, lawyers, or people with experience and resources to report this situation.

q.v: Dobbiamo convergere da ogni città per creare un unico grande blocco, un argine capace di fermare le logiche del commercio mondiale da cui dipende questo massacro.
q.e: We must converge from every city to create one large bloc, a bulwark capable of stopping the logic of global trade on which this massacre depends.

q.v: In questo clima di repressione, dove l’unica risposta che il nostro governo sà dare passa attraverso la violenza dei manganelli e l’oppressione delle libertà, noi continueremo a scendere nelle strade, continueremo a bloccare le scuole, le università, finché la Palestina non sarà libera.
q.e: In this climate of repression, where the only response our government knows how to give is through the violence of police batons and the suppression of freedoms, we will continue to take to the streets; we will continue to block schools and universities, until Palestine is free.

q.v: Noi saremo lì a contestarli e ad assediare la loro piazza insieme ai movimenti milanesi e ai No Kings che hanno espresso chiaramente in questi mesi il rifiuto globale alla deriva autoritaria e illiberale che la destra dell’ICE e della Remigrazione rappresenta.
q.e: We will be there to protest them and lay siege to their square together with the Milanese movements and the No Kings, who have clearly expressed in recent months their total rejection of the authoritarian and illiberal drift represented by the right wing of ICE and Remigration.

q.v: Lo diciamo chiaramente: non faremo avvicinare questi post-fascisti al centro sociale.
q.e: We say it clearly: we will not let these post-fascists come near the social center.

q.e: We show that we oppose capitalism by setting banks on fire. We show that we oppose authority by assassinating kings and presidents. We show that we are capable of defending ourselves from repression by blowing up police stations.

q.v: Em uma época em que a saúde é tratada como um negócio e as seguradoras estão ganhando bilhões enquanto as pessoas sofrem e morrem de doenças tratáveis sem acesso a medicamentos, matar um desses multimilionários parasitas mostra que, bem, nós nos recusamos a morrer silenciosamente de forma invisível e educada.
q.e: In an era when health is treated as a business and insurers are making billions while people suffer and die from treatable illnesses without access to medication, killing one of those multimillionaire parasites shows that, well, we refuse to die silently, invisibly, and politely.

q.v: Pensar em táticas de ação direta, como protestos, ocupações e sabotagem que possam ir de encontro às práticas ambientalmente destrutivas
q.e: Think about direct-action tactics, such as protests, occupations, and sabotage that may oppose environmentally destructive practices.

q.v: A tática específica de usar armas ou explosivos foi uma forma de criar consequências para a polícia, o governo e os ricos, quando o aparato repressivo estava matando pessoas a torto e a direito com total impunidade.
q.e: The specific tactic of using weapons or explosives was a way to create consequences for the police, the government, and the rich, when the repressive apparatus was killing people left and right with total impunity.

q.v: Do láhve je potřeba nalít benzín a motorový olej (v poměru 1:1). Neplň láhev úplně po okraj, nech místo pro výpary.
q.e: It is necessary to pour gasoline and motor oil into the bottle (in a 1:1 ratio). Do not fill the bottle completely to the brim; leave room for vapors.

q.v: Kabel ale můžeš „propálit“ – nejsnadnější způsob, jak to udělat, je umístit pájecí lampu na kabel nebo trubku a poté se rychle schovat do bezpečí.
q.e: But you can “burn through” a cable—the easiest way to do it is to place a blowtorch on the cable or pipe and then quickly hide somewhere safe.

q.v: V některých případech můžeš vyzkoušet přístup „otravného zvířete“. Ten spočívá v tom, že po dobu několika dnů či týdnů spouštíš alarmy, děláš do plotu díry, ale dovnitř nevkročíš. Hlídače to po určité době dozajista přestane bavit a pak jednou v noci nečekaně zaútočíš.
q.e: In some cases, you can try the “annoying animal” approach. It consists of setting off alarms and making holes in the fence for several days or weeks, but not entering. After a while the guard will surely get tired of it, and then one night you attack unexpectedly.

q.v: Celé to pak připevníme na plastovou nádobu s hořlavinou – směs benzínu a motorového oleje. Poměr půl na půl. Nádobu volíme podle druhu sabotovaného cíle a možností dopravení na místo. Na osobní auto postačí PETlahev nebo pružný obal od aviváže. Na budovu je vhodnější plastový kanystr většího objemu.
q.e: We then attach the whole thing to a plastic container containing a flammable mixture of gasoline and motor oil, in a fifty-fifty ratio. We choose the container according to the type of target being sabotaged and the possibilities for transporting it to the site. For a passenger car, a PET bottle or a flexible fabric-softener container is sufficient. For a building, a larger plastic canister is more suitable.

q.v: nuestra practica en cambio, debe de apuntar contra el capitalismo y sus categorías esenciales (hablamos del Trabajo, el Estado, las relaciones de genero y la democracia), así como también a perseguir a quiénes gestionan este sistema y sostienen una guerra en nuestra contra. Es tomar la contraofensiva.
q.e: Our practice, on the other hand, must be directed against capitalism and its essential categories (we are talking about Work, the State, gender relations, and democracy), as well as toward pursuing those who manage this system and sustain a war against us. It means taking the counteroffensive.

q.v: Bloquear todo. Durante la batalla de Los Ángeles, los bloqueos se extendieron desde los barrios hasta el Centro de Detención Metropolitano, y luego a las carreteras y las vías del tren. Pronto, las barricadas se dispersaron por todo el centro. A medida que el movimiento se expande, los bloqueos deben seguir extendiéndose desde los barrios hasta los centros de detención, las carreteras y las líneas de transporte público, y luego a los aeropuertos y otras infraestructuras de todo el país.
q.e: Block everything. During the Battle of Los Angeles, the blockades spread from neighborhoods to the Metropolitan Detention Center, and then to highways and train tracks. Soon, barricades were scattered throughout downtown. As the movement expands, the blockades must continue spreading from neighborhoods to detention centers, highways, and public transit lines, and then to airports and other infrastructure across the country.

q.v: Sabemos que no basta con quemar unos cuantos edificios para hacer la revolución, de lo que se trata es de propiciar un estado de ingobernabilidad en el que el orden no pueda ser restituido fácilmente, en que las instituciones no puedan dar abasto ni respuesta y demuestren sus límites e ineficiencia.
q.e: We know that burning a few buildings is not enough to make a revolution; what it is about is fostering a state of ungovernability in which order cannot be easily restored, in which institutions cannot cope or respond and demonstrate their limits and inefficiency.

q.e: Hoping that more and more actions of this kind may take place, leading to the rescue of animals whose fate seems sealed, we must continue to struggle so that vivisection and every form of animal exploitation cease completely.

q.v: La rivolta passa per la diserzione del lavoro alienato, per lo sciopero selvaggio e generalizzato, per la collaborazione nella costruzione delle vie di fuga dal sistema dello scambio economico, per l’autorganizzazione delle lotte, per il ri uto della delega e l’allontanamento di tutti i partiti e i sindacati, tutti collusi con il capitalismo.
q.e: Revolt passes through desertion from alienated labor, through wildcat and general strikes, through collaboration in building escape routes from the system of economic exchange, through the self-organization of struggles, through rejection of delegation and distancing from all parties and trade unions, all complicit with capitalism.

q.v: Per questo invitiamo le compagne e i compagni a proseguire nella tenace lotta quotidiana nelle università, nei posti di lavoro, nelle città e nelle piazze, per ricacciare questi infami vigliacchi da dove sono venuti.
q.e: For this reason, we invite comrades to continue the tenacious daily struggle in universities, workplaces, cities, and public squares, to drive these infamous cowards back where they came from.

q.e: In the ongoing catastrophe, we will not do without direct action: requisitioning and occupying land, material solidarity with farmers who want to get established without waiting for a miraculous gift from SAFER, creating AMAPs and short supply chains, multifaceted civil disobedience;

q.v: Alors tout est possible, y compris un truc dont beaucoup parmi nous ont oublié jusqu’au nom: la grève reconductible.

q.v: Les organisations syndicales soutiennent notre collègue inspectrice du travail, dénoncent ces attaques et appellent tous les agents du ministère à se mettre en grève et à se rassembler le 5 Juin 2015 à 13h30 devant le tribunal correctionnel d’Annecy pour protester contre cette énième tentative de détruire notre collègue et d’humilier nos services.
q.e: The trade-union organizations support our colleague, the labour inspector, denounce these attacks, and call on all ministry employees to go on strike and gather on 5 June 2015 at 1:30 p.m. in front of Annecy criminal court to protest this latest attempt to destroy our colleague and humiliate our services.

q.v: L’heure est à la mobilisation générale: Lycéen-e-s, étudiant-e-s, salarié-e-s du privé et du public, chômeuses/eurs, retraité-e-s, sont invités à préparer activement dans l’unité la plus large des organisations qui demandent le retrait du projet de loi Travail, la grève interprofessionnelle, privé / public, du jeudi 28 avril
q.e: The time has come for general mobilization: high-school students, university students, private- and public-sector employees, unemployed people, and retirees are invited to actively prepare, in the broadest unity of organizations demanding withdrawal of the Labour Bill, for the private/public interprofessional strike on Thursday 28 April.

blogs.sum: French-language revolutionary/anarchist-oriented blog publishing extended theoretical polemics on riots, insurrection, revolution, and criticism of organized leftism. The post frames unmediated riots as potentially foundational moments for emancipatory debate and revolutionary development, while explicitly arguing that riots cannot be called for or externally initiated.

q.v: L’émeute est un moment où les pauvres se battent sans encadrement, et sans la médiation de l’Etat, de la marchandise et de l’information dominante, et souvent contre eux.
q.e: A riot is a moment when the poor fight without supervision, and without the mediation of the State, commodities, and dominant information, and often against them.

ne: De l’émeute moderne et de l’archaïsme gauchiste

blogs.sum: Blog covering urban-land and housing organizing in Barquisimeto, Lara, Venezuela, including a residents' movement march demanding implementation of housing projects and land-access mechanisms. blogs.sum: Portuguese-language radical-left blog publishing a Zapatista/EZLN communiqué addressed to anti-capitalists and supporters of Indigenous struggles. The post rejects institutional electoral politics and foregrounds state violence, gendered violence, disappearances, repression, Indigenous dispossession, migrant harm, and ecological destruction. It appears to function as a dissemination platform for Zapatista and allied movement material.

blogs.sum: Brazilian anarchist collective centered on the Okupa 171 occupied social space. It documents events and workshops while hosting anti-capitalist, anti-extractivist organizing, including a public discussion of IIRSA and a call for decentralized actions against it.

q.v: MORTE AO ESTADO, VIVA A ANARKIA!!!! FLOR DO ASFALTO RESISTE!!!!!! SAUDE E VIOLENCIA NA RESISTENCIA!!!!
q.e: DEATH TO THE STATE, LONG LIVE ANARCHY!!!! FLOR DO ASFALTO RESISTS!!!!!! HEALTH AND VIOLENCE IN RESISTANCE!!!!

q.v: A todos os que sentem o impulso e a motivação pela liberação da terra chamamos a realizar durante o mês de junho, ou para sempre, todo tipo de ações multiformes, propaganda, sabotagem, solidariedade, atividades, agitação de rua, e tudo o que queiram imaginar.
q.e: To all those who feel the impulse and motivation for the liberation of the land, we call on you to carry out during the month of June, or forever, all kinds of multifaceted actions, propaganda, sabotage, solidarity, activities, street agitation, and everything you want to imagine.

q.e: It is necessary that all groups and individuals who identify with opposition to these anti-popular measures mobilize to encourage the broadest participation and the greatest success of the strike and future initiatives.

q.v: Crediamo necessaria una mobilitazione forte e continuativa che sappia far vivere questo processo in città e non solo.

q.v: L’unica via per invertire questa tendenza è la lotta quotidiana all’interno dell’università per una riappropriazione sistematica degli spazi, con ogni mezzo necessario.

blogs.sum: A long-running grassroots committee opposing the proposed Rome–Latina toll motorway and the Cisterna–Valmontone link road. It publishes press releases criticizing public spending, environmental and traffic impacts, and opaque procurement, while advocating safety upgrades to Via Pontina, rail intermodality, and freight transport by rail.

q.v: Invitiamo tutte/i a non arrendersi, perché un atto ingiusto trasformato in legge è violenza. Per questo motivo è nostro dovere resistere e continuare la lotta con altri mezzi a partire da presidi permanenti e azioni dirette.
q.e: We invite everyone not to give up, because an unjust act turned into law is violence. For this reason, it is our duty to resist and continue the struggle by other means, starting with permanent pickets and direct actions.

q.v: Nel denunciare l’ennesima aggressione al nostro territorio, invitiamo tutta la cittadinanza ad opporsi ed autorganizzarsi per la tutela della salute e dell’ambiente Venerdi manifestazione su via del risaro ore 17.30 partenza dalla piazzetta di Vitinia o dalla Piazza del Mercato Tor de Cenci
q.e: In denouncing yet another attack on our territory, we invite all citizens to oppose it and self-organize to protect health and the environment. Friday demonstration on Via del Risaro at 5:30 p.m., departing from the small square in Vitinia or from the Market Square in Tor de Cenci.

q.v: Ci appelliamo a tutte/i gli uomini e le donne liberi/e, alla cittadinanza attiva, affinché come un solo corpo vivo ed ecoresistente si compattino unitariamente e fraternamente al nostro movimento autonomo e indipendente per bloccare la devastazione.
q.e: We appeal to all free men and women, to active citizens, so that, as one living and eco-resistant body, they unite collectively and fraternally with our autonomous and independent movement to stop the devastation.

q.v: Visto che l’autostrada Roma-Latina è la prima delle opere elencate in questo decreto tanto veloce a superare tutto e tutti pur di devastare la nostra terra, i Nodi Territoriali dei Comitati NOcorridoio/NObretella, daranno una prima risposta di ferma e rinnovata opposizione, con un PRESIDIO sotto la sede del Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti il 15 Luglio 2020 dalle ore 14,30 in Piazza di Porta Pia,1 a Roma.
q.e: Given that the Rome–Latina motorway is the first of the projects listed in this decree, which is so quick to override everything and everyone in order to devastate our land, the Territorial Nodes of the NOcorridoio/NObretella Committees will give an initial response of firm and renewed opposition, with a PROTEST PICKET outside the headquarters of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport on 15 July 2020 from 2:30 p.m. at Piazza di Porta Pia 1 in Rome.

q.v: Dovremmo alzare il livello di conflitto a difesa delle terre e degli agricoltori che sono sul tracciato della bretella, soggette ad esproprio, ribadisco ad ESPROPRIO, nelle prossime settimane.
q.e: We should raise the level of conflict in defense of the lands and farmers who are on the route of the connector road, subject to expropriation—expropriation, I repeat—in the coming weeks.

blogs.sum: Naples-based radical collective focused on housing struggles, occupations and reappropriation of abandoned urban spaces, anti-privatization, environmental mobilization against landfills/incinerators, and solidarity with Palestine including a cultural boycott campaign.

q.e: We must defend ourselves by every means against the attack and the poisons of profiteers and power lobbies;

q.v: Bloccare il normale processo di funzionamento della metropoli per uscire dalle nostre facoltà e poter comunicare e urlare a gran voce a tutti i settori sociali
q.e: To disrupt the normal functioning of the metropolis, so as to leave our faculties and communicate and loudly shout to all social sectors

q.v: Non si può rimanere indifferenti, impediamo la “marcia su Napoli”.
q.e: We cannot remain indifferent; let us prevent the “march on Naples.”

q.v: – Per costruire uno Sciopero Generale e Generalizzato! Per assediare i palazzi del potere!
q.e: – To build a General and Generalized Strike! To besiege the palaces of power!

q.e: It is up to us to challenge this kind of initiative, instead giving space to the everyday Palestinian resistance! BOYCOTT THE NAPLES THEATRE FESTIVAL! BOYCOTT CULTURE THAT DOES NOT TAKE A STAND!

Rennes-based support and counter-information blog focused on the Notre-Dame-des-Landes ZAD, especially eviction threats, negotiations, land struggles, and solidarity involving local postal workers. It mainly aggregates reporting and movement media about defending the ZAD.

q.v: Le comité zad de Rennes vous invite: Mardi 17 mai 2016, à partir de 14h Place du Parlement * Venez nombreux! * En cas d’impossibilité d’accéder à la Place du Parlement (dispositif policier aidant!) le rassemblement se tiendra Place Hoche.
q.e: The Rennes ZAD committee invites you: Tuesday, 17 May 2016, from 2 p.m., at Place du Parlement. Come in large numbers! If it is impossible to access Place du Parlement (because of the police deployment!), the gathering will take place at Place Hoche.

q.v: Nous vous invitons à nous alerter de fuites sur les entreprises privées qui pourraient être impliquées (défrichage, gardiennage, etc.), d’infos sur les hôtels qui accueilleraient les gendarmes, de circulaires, notes internes et autres bruits de couloir concernant cette opération, ainsi que de mouvements de troupes autour de la ZAD
q.e: We invite you to alert us to leaks concerning private companies that might be involved (clearing, security, etc.), information about hotels that might be accommodating gendarmes, circulars, internal notes and other rumors concerning this operation, as well as troop movements around the ZAD.

q.v: Les flics sont usés, continuons le boulot. Le comité Zad de Rennes appel le à des actions décentralisées dans toutes nos villes, le jour même où ils reprennent les opérations d’expulsion.
q.e: The cops are worn out; let’s continue the work. The Zad Committee of Rennes calls for decentralized actions in all our cities, on the very day they resume eviction operations.

q.v: Le lendemain 7h30, action, rdv métro république 12h30, AG à la fac Rennes 2 Le sur-lendemain 7h30, pour une nouvelle action Les jours qui suivent AG, action, manif etc., jusqu’aux retraits des troupes!
q.e: The next day: 7:30 a.m., action; meeting point at République metro. 12:30 p.m., general assembly at Rennes 2 university. The day after that: 7:30 a.m., for another action. In the following days: general assembly, action, demonstration, etc., until the troops withdraw!

q.v: Bonjour à tous! Nous rappelons que de nouvelles expulsions sur la ZAD sont imminentes. Préparons nous donc à réagir! Nous défendrons tous les lieux! En cas d’expulsions, comme d’habitude: RDV 18h place Ste Anne.
q.e: Hello everyone! We remind you that new evictions on the ZAD are imminent. Let us therefore prepare to react! We will defend all the places! In the event of evictions, as usual: meet at 6 p.m. at Place Ste Anne.

q.v: Leghista, ogni volta che verrai qui non sarai mai in pace come vorresti: ci sarà sempre una Taranto antifascista, antirazzista e solidale che respingerà ogni tua sporca retorica.

q.v: E sciolgeremo le redini, spezzeremo le catene, alzeremo al cielo i nostri bambini e le nostre bambine e voi, voi che ci governate, voi che ridete con i Riva per le morti di tumore, voi… ecco, voi sperate di non esserci.
q.e: And we will loosen the reins, break the chains, raise our children to the sky, and you—you who govern us, you who laugh with the Rivas over cancer deaths—you... well, you should hope not to be there.

q.v: Una liberazione diretta di alcuni individui funge, in questo caso come sempre, da messaggio simbolico ed inequivocabile a rappresentanza della volontà di chi considera gli animali dei compagni oppressi che devono essere, senza eccezione alcuna, liberati.

Padua-based radical student collective blog documenting university occupations, self-managed spaces, anti-austerity organizing, and Palestine solidarity events. It frames the occupation of unused university buildings as collective resistance to privatized education and repression.

q.v: nulla ci sarà concesso se non incominciamo a pensare che molte cose bisogna prendersele, anche con la forza.

q.v: la violenza contro il potere è legittima in quanto difesa di fronte ad una violenza ben più grande e organizzata.
q.e: Violence against power is legitimate insofar as it is a defense in the face of a much greater and more organized violence.

q.v: dobbiamo conquistarci quegli spazi e quei tempi che oggi ci vengono negati e non lo si potrà fare in altro modo che attraverso nuove occupazioni.
q.e: We must win for ourselves those spaces and times that are denied to us today, and it cannot be done in any way other than through new occupations.

q.v: Mettiamo i bastoni tra le ruote a chi collabora attivamente alla militarizzazione, come la Sitaf che ha consentito l’apertura in autostrada di un corridoio per il passaggio dei militari e delle ruspe, aumentando contemporaneamente i pedaggi autostradali.
q.e: Let us throw obstacles in the way of those who actively collaborate in militarization, such as Sitaf, which allowed a corridor to be opened on the motorway for the passage of military personnel and bulldozers, while at the same time increasing motorway tolls.

q.v: Quest’anno l’obiettivo era di avvicinarsi alle reti a viso scoperto per cercare di tagliarle tutti assieme.

q.e: For example, micro-rallies (several people with loudspeakers outline a short speech that lasts no longer than the time it takes for the traffic light to change) during rush hour or periods of heavy pedestrian traffic near workplaces cost little and reach many people.

q.v: La idea es movilizar a las mujeres, incluidas las mujeres transgénero, y todos los que las apoyan, en una jornada de lucha internacional: una jornada de huelgas, manifestaciones, bloqueo de carreteras, puentes y plazas, en la que nos abstengamos de toda labor doméstica, asistencial y sexual, boicoteemos y denunciemos a políticos y empresas misóginas y hagamos huelga en centros de enseñanza.
q.e: The idea is to mobilize women, including transgender women, and all those who support them, in an international day of struggle: a day of strikes, demonstrations, blocking roads, bridges and plazas, in which we refrain from all domestic, care and sexual labor, boycott and denounce misogynist politicians and companies, and strike in educational centers.

q.v: Anche il cosiddetto diritto internazionale, pur censurando gli atti di aperta pirateria di Israele, ne ha pienamente legittimato le spoliazioni e le violenze originarie, e nelle risoluzioni dell’ONU e nelle sentenze delle corti internazionali non viene mai riconosciuto il diritto dei palestinesi alla lotta armata per la riconquista piena e senza resti della loro terra.
q.e: So-called international law, too, while censuring Israel’s acts of outright piracy, has fully legitimized its original dispossessions and violence; and neither UN resolutions nor international-court judgments ever recognize the Palestinians’ right to armed struggle for the full and total reconquest of their land.

q.v: I palestinesi dissero no, e insorsero! La Resistenza palestinese, vecchia di un secolo, organizzò e guidò l’insurrezione.
q.e: The Palestinians said no, and rose up! The Palestinian Resistance, a century old, organized and led the insurrection.

q.v: All’inizio di Ottobre, per la seconda volta, si commemora una grande insurrezione palestinese, avvenuta il 7 Ottobre 2023. Si tratta di commemorazioni di lotta, di una lotta autentica che non nasconde la rabbia, il dolore e un’irriducibile volontà d’azione.
q.e: At the beginning of October, for the second time, a great Palestinian insurrection that took place on 7 October 2023 is commemorated. These are commemorations of struggle, of an authentic struggle that does not hide anger, pain, and an irreducible will to act.

q.v: Sta a noi sconvolgere questi piani: BLOCCHIAMO TUTTO!
q.e: It is up to us to disrupt these plans: LET’S BLOCK EVERYTHING!

q.v: La rettifica riguarda le forme di lotta, che devono avanzare qualitativamente, incominciando a rompere vincoli e impedimenti, ad acquisire spazi, ad occupare luoghi, a rendere materialmente tangibili i mezzi d’azione e a riappropriarsi di beni sociali sottratti e recintati a beneficio del profitto capitalistico e dei piaceri dei possidenti.
q.e: The rectification concerns the forms of struggle, which must advance qualitatively, beginning to break constraints and impediments, acquire spaces, occupy places, make the means of action materially tangible, and reappropriate social goods taken away and fenced off for the benefit of capitalist profit and the pleasures of the propertied classes.

q.v: Jaksa, sipir, polisi, atau siapa pun kolaborator yang mengabdi pada dunia hari ini—jangan tidur dengan tenang. Kami terus mengasah gagasan-gagasan kami dan menjadikannya ancaman nyata terhadap kalian.
q.e: Prosecutors, prison guards, police, or any collaborator serving today's world—do not sleep soundly. We continue sharpening our ideas and making them a real threat against you.

q.v: Ini proyek yang mustahil berkumpul bersama teman-teman dan nonaktifkan semua kamera keamanan di kota Anda, dan nyatakan sebagai zona bebas aksi.

q.v: Saat kami memilih membakar simbol-simbol kekuasaan rakus dan serakah. Saat kami memilih merusak halte dan fasilitas umum lainnya. Saat kami memilih melempari dan menghancurkan mobil polisi yang melindas dan membunuh saudara kami.
q.e: When we choose to burn the symbols of greedy and avaricious power. When we choose to damage bus stops and other public facilities. When we choose to pelt and destroy police cars that run over and kill our brothers and sisters.

Maresca hospital—which for the city of Torre del Greco and neighboring towns constitutes the only emergency-service network in the Vesuvian area—together with a large group of women and men citizens, occupied the municipal buildings.

q.e: After night fell on October 17, we installed an explosive device inside the headquarters of the National Academy of Political and Strategic Studies (ANEPE), on the eve of a new commemoration of the October uprising.

q.v: Durante la madrugada de éste 20 octubre nos movilizamos sigilosxs y decididxs por las calles de Derqui para darle mecha a la terminal de autobuses de dicha localidad y el más bello de los purificadores se desarrolló a gusto.
q.e: During the early hours of October 20, we moved stealthily and resolutely through the streets of Derqui to set fire to the bus terminal in that locality, and the most beautiful of purifiers unfolded to our satisfaction.

q.v: L’unica possibilità che abbiamo davanti a questo impasse è dare vita ad un conflitto irrecuperabile realizzabile solo se, analizzando le dinamiche di dominio che promuovono un determinato sfruttamento, si riescono ad identificare non solo le strutture ma anche i ruoli che sullo sfruttamento costruiscono e mantengono il loro potere (economico e sociale) colpendo il meccanismo capitalista che produce la distruzione degli animali.
q.e: The only possibility before us in this impasse is to give rise to an irrecoverable conflict, achievable only if, by analysing the dynamics of domination that promote a particular exploitation, we can identify not only the structures but also the roles that build and maintain their (economic and social) power on exploitation, striking the capitalist mechanism that produces the destruction of animals.

q.v: Bisogna necessariamente volgere lo sguardo a chi, per antica tradizione o moderne opere di sfruttamento, è segregato contro la sua volontà e adoperarsi per la sua evasione, anche evidentemente qualora fosse imprigionato in castelli dorati.
q.e: It is necessary to turn one’s gaze to those who, through ancient tradition or modern works of exploitation, are segregated against their will and to work for their escape, even, evidently, if they are imprisoned in golden castles.

blogs.sum: French-language anarchist/insurrectionist blog combining poetic cultural writing with explicitly anti-state, anti-capitalist revolutionary essays. It rejects reformism, electoral left and NGOs, frames insurrection as necessary, and rhetorically endorses sabotage alongside overthrowing class power.

q.v: Nous opposerons notre violence révolutionnaire à votre violence bien huilée, d’état et de marché. Nous multiplierons les tactiques et quand il le faudra, nous saccagerons ce qu’il faudra saccager, ces quelques bureaux et effigies, pour rappeler aux vrais saccageurs, ceux en costumes, la brutalité première de leurs actes.
q.e: We will counter your well-oiled violence—that of the state and the market—with our revolutionary violence. We will multiply our tactics and, when necessary, we will smash up what needs smashing up—those few offices and effigies—to remind the real vandals, those in suits, of the fundamental brutality of their actions.

q.v: Nous avons aussi brisé des vitrines, détruit des distributeurs, eux qui distribuent, en effet, bien des cauchemars et si peu de rêves. Nous l’avons fait et le referont car nous ne sommes toujours pas entendus: nous voulons la chute du régime
q.e: We also smashed shop windows and destroyed cash machines—machines that, indeed, dispense many nightmares and so few dreams. We did it and will do it again because we still are not being heard: we want the fall of the regime.

q.v: Disons nous le en clair: si les ultra-riches n’ont aucun intérêt à ce que s’arrêtent leur commerce de la mort, nous devrons les renverser, les ruiner, avant que tout ne devienne, finalement — ruine.
q.e: Let us say it clearly: if the ultra-rich have no interest in stopping their commerce of death, we will have to overthrow them, ruin them, before everything finally becomes—ruin.

q.v: Nous n’avons pas d’autre alternative que celle du soulèvement. Il n’est plus temps de perdre notre temps sur les symptômes mais d’attaquer la maladie. Il ne s’agit donc plus de réformer l’état ou le capital — l’un ayant depuis longtemps prouvé sa soumission à l’autre — mais de les détruire pour de bon;
q.e: We have no alternative other than uprising. It is no longer time to waste our time on symptoms but to attack the disease. It is therefore no longer about reforming the state or capital—one having long proven its submission to the other—but about destroying them for good;

blogs.sum: Italian radical-left/anarchist publishing and movement blog. It circulates anti-war and anti-repression mobilization material, frames war and policing as class repression, and memorializes an anarchist comrade associated with occupations, prisoner visits, and direct-action politics.

q.v: Noi siamo quelli che la vogliamo fare qui. Quelli che organizzano i lavoratori e i disoccupati di Grisolia, che innalzano le barricate, che circondano la caserma dei carabinieri, che difendono la fabbrica occupata dagli sgherri e dai mafiosi con le armi.
q.e: We are those who want to do it here. Those who organize the workers and unemployed people of Grisolia, who raise barricades, who surround the Carabinieri barracks, who defend the occupied factory from thugs and mafiosi with weapons.

q.v: Caso emblematico le straordinarie rivolte che hanno riguardato una cinquantina di carceri italiane, devastando e rendendo inagibili dozzine di sezioni, con un grandioso episodio di evasione collettiva a Foggia.
q.e: An emblematic case is the extraordinary riots involving around fifty Italian prisons, devastating and rendering unusable dozens of sections, with a magnificent episode of collective escape in Foggia.

It explicitly seeks to bring new students into local political engagement and organizing, with anti-capitalist and anti-fascist framing.

blogs.sum: French radical-left blog documenting and commenting on local struggles in Toulouse, including anti-police protest accounts, anti-militarist education criticism, and solidarity with a Portuguese antifascist facing prosecution. Its writing is anarchist/antifascist in orientation and presents protest disruption and confrontation with police as legitimate elements of resistance.

q.v: A cette violence d’état, ne reste que deux réponses possibles: soit se terrer en laissant faire, soit riposter.
q.e: In response to this state violence, only two possible answers remain: either hole up and let it happen, or strike back.

q.v: Alors après s’être fait disperser une première fois au croisement de la Colombette, les plus déterminé.e.s sont allé.e.s au carton, rentrant dans le lard des condés postés comme des vautours rue Labéda. Les repousser un moment pour caler quelques feux de poubelles qui protègera le gros de la troupe
q.e: So, after being dispersed for the first time at the Colombette intersection, the most determined people got into a fight, charging the cops stationed like vultures on rue Labéda. They pushed them back for a while in order to set a few dumpster fires that would protect the bulk of the group.

blogs.sum: Freiburg-based anarchist/anti-repression support collective (Ermittlungsausschuss) providing legal-support reporting, security guidance, rights workshops, and organizing infrastructure for people affected by police measures in antifascist, climate, and other political activism. It also publicizes opposition to surveillance companies and police repression.

q.v: Solidarische Menschen antworteten auf den Überfall mit Feuerwerk, Steinen und Farbe, Barrikaden wurden errichtet, UnterstützerInnen kamen nach der Razzia vorbei, um kaputte Infrastruktur zu reparieren.
q.e: People acting in solidarity responded to the raid with fireworks, stones, and paint; barricades were erected, and supporters came by after the raid to repair damaged infrastructure.

blogs.sum: Italian radical-left local collective/blog in the Alto Milanese area. It promotes anti-austerity and anti-capitalist mobilizations, commons and welfare demands, solidarity with migrants, anti-war activity, anti-fascist/partisan memory, and resistance to the eviction of a social space ('La Fornace'). Posts explicitly mobilize readers for demonstrations in Rome and broader territorial organizing.

q.v: Ci piace vedere i giovani nelle strade, gli studenti e le studentesse costruire il loro futuro bloccando le città oggi in segno di protesta!
q.e: We like seeing young people in the streets, male and female students building their future by blocking cities today as a sign of protest!

q.v: Poi le forze dell’ordine usano i blindati per caricare le persone e disperderle perchè sono battutti più volte dalla terminazione delle MIGLIAIA di manifestanti che invadono e tengono piazza del Popolo
q.e: Then the police use armored vehicles to charge at people and disperse them because they have been beaten back several times by the determination of the THOUSANDS of demonstrators who invade and hold Piazza del Popolo.

q.v: piazza del Popolo diventa un campo di battaglia dove le forze dell’ordine, coloro che difendono i governi arroganti e presuntuosi, non possono abusare del loro potere perchè migliaia e migliaia di protestanti le respingono lontano, non si fanno intimidire
q.e: Piazza del Popolo becomes a battlefield where the police, those who defend arrogant and presumptuous governments, cannot abuse their power because thousands and thousands of protesters push them back far away and are not intimidated.

q.v: La Fornace è un nostro patrimonio. Lo difenderemo. Con la politica e con i nostri corpi.
q.e: The Fornace is our heritage. We will defend it. With politics and with our bodies.

q.v: Il 15 ottobre tutti a Roma, contro la crisi e per l’alternativa!

Asturian-language blog of a long-running volunteer-run solidarity bar/kiosk at Oviedo's San Mateo festivities. The post announces that the project will stop operating after 33 years and recounts its role as a fundraising and visibility platform for local social movements, including labor, feminist, LGBTQ+, anti-racist, migrant, environmental, anti-war, and linguistic-rights causes.

Catalan-language anarchist-oriented material-sharing blog that republishes posters, leaflets, calls, and texts from neighborhood and street activity. blogs.n: Dresden 17. Juni – Gemeinsam gegen den Naziaufmarsch
blogs.sum: A Dresden-based broad antifascist alliance that mobilized counter-demonstrations, rallies, legal-support contacts, medics, live updates, and protest logistics against an NPD/neonazi march on 17 June 2013. It frames its activity as civil disobedience and collective non-escalatory resistance to the march.

q.v: Zu allen Veranstaltungen laden wir herzlich ein, sich mit uns aktiv gegen die Nazis und ihre menschenverachtende Ideologie zu stellen.
q.e: We warmly invite you to all events to actively take a stand with us against the Nazis and their contempt for humanity.

q.v: Wir rufen alle Menschen auf, sich gemeinsam, mit uns, den Nazis auch am 17. Juni in den Weg zu stellen.
q.e: We call on all people to stand together with us in the Nazis’ way on 17 June as well.

q.v: Wir leisten zivilen Ungehorsam gegen braunes Gedankengut. Dabei wird von uns keine Eskalation ausgehen. Wir sind solidarisch mit allen, die das Ziel teilen, den Naziaufmarsch zu verhindern.
q.e: We engage in civil disobedience against brown ideology. There will be no escalation from us in doing so. We stand in solidarity with everyone who shares the goal of preventing the Nazi march.

q.v: Lasst uns gemeinsam dafür sorgen, dass sie so kurz wie möglich, so lächerlich wie möglich und so frustrierend wie möglich für die NPD wird!
q.e: Let us work together to ensure that it is as short as possible, as ridiculous as possible, and as frustrating as possible for the NPD!

blogs.sum: Spanish-language anarchist/militant blog defending Black Bloc masking and confrontational self-defense in protests. It rejects pacifism, argues against claims that masked protesters are police provocateurs, and frames street militancy and resistance to police as necessary for strengthening social movements.

q.v: Al contrario que en Inglaterra, la población griega ha estado tirando piedras o cócteles molotov contra bancos y policía durante décadas, y nunca han permitido que su gobierno fuera lo suficientemente fuerte como para regular las protestas en las calle o para implementar un espionaje y represión efectivas.
q.e: In contrast to England, the Greek population has been throwing stones or Molotov cocktails at banks and the police for decades, and has never allowed its government to become strong enough to regulate street protests or to implement effective surveillance and repression.

blogs.sum: Spanish-language radical anarchist/insurrectionary counter-information blog that republishes communiqués, prisoner statements, and claims of attacks linked to Greek armed anarchist groups, including Conspiracy of Cells of Fire (CCF) and Revolutionary Struggle. Its posts endorse and disseminate targeted violence and urban-guerrilla organizing rhetoric.

q.v: Atacamos pasada la medianoche del miércoles 27 de abril de 2016 con una bomba incendiaria de fabricación casera compuesta por un bidón repleto de bencina y quinientos gramos de poliestireno, adosamos también al material incendiario dos cartuchos de gas butano/propano buscando generar mayor daño a la puerta principal del Círculo de Retiro de Gendarmería ubicado en José Toribio Medina #72.
q.e: After midnight on Wednesday, April 27, 2016, we attacked with a homemade incendiary bomb consisting of a container filled with gasoline and five hundred grams of polystyrene; we also attached two butane/propane gas cartridges to the incendiary device, seeking to cause greater damage to the main door of the Gendarmerie Retirement Circle located at José Toribio Medina No. 72.

q.v: utilizando diablos y combos para violar la seguridad paupérrima de estas, para luego vertir dos litros de acelerante (1/4 de parafina y ¾ de bencina) en cada uno de los perfectos forados que quedan al extraer la placa de cierre
q.e: using crowbars and sledgehammers to breach their extremely poor security, then pouring two liters of accelerant (1/4 paraffin and 3/4 gasoline) into each of the openings left when removing the closing plate

q.v: este llamado nace para que los fiscales, policías y gendarmes tengan claro que nuestrxs compañerxs NO ESTÁN SOLXS, tiene una manada a su lado que no claudicara y no dudara poner los cuchillos en sus cuellos el fuego en su cuerpo y el plomo en sus cabezas.
q.e: This call arises so that prosecutors, police officers, and gendarmes understand clearly that our comrades ARE NOT ALONE; they have a pack at their side that will not yield and will not hesitate to put knives in their necks, fire in their bodies, and lead in their heads.

q.v: hacemos el llamado a las voluntades rebeldes e insurrectas a propagar la acción liberadora en nombre del Maury, que resuene en propaganda, en barricadas, en un continuo de ataque al orden.
q.e: We call on rebellious and insurrectionary wills to spread liberating action in Maury’s name, so that it resonates in propaganda, in barricades, in a continuous attack on order.

q.v: ¡Contra el poder y su venganza hacia lxs compañerxs que continúan la lucha en las prisiones…A extender la solidaridad ofensiva con acción insurrecta!
q.e: Against power and its revenge against comrades who continue the struggle in prisons… Let us extend offensive solidarity through insurrectionary action!

q.v: Non necessitiamo di un motivo per attaccare questi esseri in divisa, la loro esistenza e violenza basta a renderlo più che accettabile, direi giusto. All Cops are Bastard, All cops are target.
q.e: We do not need a reason to attack these uniformed beings; their existence and violence are enough to make it more than acceptable—indeed, right. All cops are bastards; all cops are targets.

q.v: E poco ci interessa se qualche banca, mc donald o azienda complice di Israele e delle torture nei cpr dovrà spendere due spiccioli per la sua vetrina, ne siamo solo felici,
q.e: And we care little if some bank, McDonald’s, or company complicit in Israel and in the torture in CPRs has to spend a few pennies on its shop window; we are only happy about it,

q.v: Se vogliamo davvero che la paura cambi lato È in quella casa che ci devono sentire, quelle le finestre che per prime dovranno piangere i vetri delle nostre pietre e bottiglie di rabbia quelli i muri che dovranno sanguinare.
q.e: If we truly want fear to change sides, that is the house where they must hear us; those are the windows that must be the first to weep their glass under our stones and bottles of rage; those are the walls that must bleed.

blogs.sum: Santiago-based anarchist social and organizing space publishing frequent announcements for anti-authoritarian events, prisoner-solidarity collections, anarchist propaganda fundraising, political discussions, memory activities, and cultural gatherings. It explicitly promotes anarchist ideas and frames events around direct action, expropriation, resistance, and solidarity with anarchist prisoners.

q.v: Tomar la determinación de atacar la institución carcelaria es un ejemplo concreto de la materialización de la solidaridad anticarcelaria.
q.e: Making the decision to attack the prison institution is a concrete example of the materialization of anti-prison solidarity.

q.v: Revisitar nuestra historia para sacar lecciones y aprendizajes, hilando pasado y presente en un continuo histórico que busca la destrucción hermosamente violenta de todo Poder.
q.e: Revisiting our history to draw lessons and learning from it, weaving past and present into a historical continuum that seeks the beautifully violent destruction of all Power.

q.v: La violencia anárquica como herramienta sigue su curso, jamás extinguiéndose, (re)configurándose también en las últimas décadas de forma teórica y práctica, convirtiéndose en la pesadilla de muchxs.
q.e: Anarchist violence as a tool continues on its course, never dying out, also (re)configuring itself in recent decades in theoretical and practical form, becoming the nightmare of many.

q.v: Solidaridad con quienes pasan a la acción y no son meros espectadores de la explotación animal.
q.e: Solidarity with those who take action and are not mere spectators of animal exploitation.

q.v: Desde una perspectiva anárquica, a través de la lectura y la práctica, buscamos retroalimentarnos, tensionar y defender la violencia política desatada en aquellos meses incontrolables.
q.e: From an anarchist perspective, through reading and practice, we seek to mutually learn from one another, problematize, and defend the political violence unleashed during those uncontrollable months.

q.v: Isto confirma-nos que sem perder de vista a nossa posição contra os estados e seus mecanismos, há uma luta premente que passa por todo o tipo de educação contra-capitalista e boicote ao capitalismo, quer pela destruição, quer pela organização de circuitos desviantes do consumismo (troca, respigagem, hortas comunitárias, apropriação, ocupação, roubo organizado para redistribuição).
q.e: This confirms to us that, without losing sight of our position against states and their mechanisms, there is a pressing struggle involving every kind of anti-capitalist education and boycott of capitalism, whether through destruction or through organizing circuits deviating from consumerism (exchange, gleaning, community gardens, appropriation, occupation, organized theft for redistribution).

q.v: Mardi 28 mars et les jours suivants, renforçons les grèves et les blocages, prenons les rues, pour S. et tous les blessés et les enfermés de nos mouvements.
q.e: Tuesday, March 28, and in the days that follow, let us strengthen the strikes and blockades; let us take to the streets, for S. and all those injured and imprisoned from our movements.

q.v: Nous refusons leur défaite programmée et pour ça, à plein d’endroits, des formes d’organisations ont émergé pour nous permettre de prendre l’initiative et de renforcer la lutte, par les assemblées, par les occupations, par les manifs, par les grèves, par les blocages, par les sabotages.
q.e: We reject their planned defeat, and to that end, in many places, forms of organization have emerged to enable us to take the initiative and strengthen the struggle: through assemblies, occupations, demonstrations, strikes, blockades, and sabotage.

q.v: Nous demandons également à toutes celles et ceux qui en France et autour du monde se reconnaîtront dans cet appel à faire de la semaine du 1er mai une semaine intensive d’actions contre l’État et le capital: au travail, dans les cortèges, sur les ronds-points, en dédicace à tous nos camarades blessés, tués et enfermés, d’ici et d’ailleurs, d’hier et d’aujourd’hui, qui ne peuvent pas y participer.
q.e: We also ask all those in France and around the world who identify with this call to make the week of 1 May an intensive week of actions against the State and capital: at work, in demonstrations, at roundabouts, dedicated to all our comrades who have been injured, killed, or imprisoned, here and elsewhere, yesterday and today, who cannot take part.

q.v: Retrouvons nous pour discuter de comment, sur Alès et dans le Gard, rejoindre l’appel à mobilisation pour le 10 septembre.
q.e: Let us meet to discuss how, in Alès and the Gard, to join the call to mobilize for 10 September.

q.v: Retrouvons nous pour construire le rapport de force nécessaire pour faire plier l’État et la classe capitaliste. Rendez-vous mardi 30 septembre à 19h à la Rétive (42 rue du faubourg d’Auvergne – Alès)
q.e: Let us meet to build the balance of power necessary to make the State and the capitalist class bend. Meet on Tuesday 30 September at 7 p.m. at La Rétive (42 rue du faubourg d’Auvergne, Alès).
