q.v: Warum Telekom? Sicher, technisch ist die Telekom ein überaus reizvolles Ziel: Neben einem riesigen Fuhrpark, Dependancen in nahezu jeder Stadt der BRD und ihren Werbeständen in den Fußgängerzonen, besitzt der Konzern ein weitläufiges (schwer zu wschützendes) Netz an Kabeln und Leitungen kreuz und quer durch die Republik, sowie etliche Funk- und Sendemasten die irgendwo unbewacht in der Pampa stehen.
q.e: Why Telekom? Certainly, technically Telekom is an extremely attractive target: Besides a huge vehicle fleet, branches in nearly every city in the Federal Republic of Germany and its advertising stands in pedestrian zones, the corporation has an extensive (difficult to protect) network of cables and lines crisscrossing the republic, as well as numerous radio and transmission masts that stand somewhere unguarded in the middle of nowhere.

q.e: Attack is the most beautiful moment that an anarchist can experience. Feeling adrenaline flowing rapidly as you rush toward a window with a stone in your hand, or in the moments before attacking police with your fists. Planting bombs, pulling the trigger, shouting the slogan “FUCK THE POLICE!”

q.v: Tong sampah dilemparkan ke jalan dan dibakar, objek dilempar ke arah polis. Nada dan aura perlawanan serta kemarahan yang memuncak bertukar menjadi detik paling menarik dalam hidup anda yang membosankan.
q.e: Trash bins are thrown into the street and burned; objects are thrown at the police. The tone and aura of resistance and mounting anger become the most exciting moment in your boring life.

q.v: On the night of May 13th and 14th, we joined forces with the informal network of scattered cells worldwide to locate and attack the agents of repression and social / State control.

Whether it is revolts that escape the control of the authorities during the G20 summit, whether it is sabotages on telecommunication infrastructure, arsons on police stations or attacks on the companies profiting off the prison industry, these give signs and strength to other fighters and dreamers.
On the night of September 4th, 2019, we destroyed with fire a vehicle belonging to the infamous prison profiteers SPIE in Hamburg-Wandsbeck.
We would like to spread this fight, draw attention to it and motivate more groups to focus on the prison profiteers.

q.e: The aim of a picket may be to cripple or halt production by preventing supplies from being delivered to the workplace and blocking the distribution of products to customers.

q.v: OKUPAČNÍ STÁVKA Jde o stávku, kdy stávkující odmítnou opustit pracoviště, dokud nejsou jejich požadavky splněné. Často při tom dochází k zablokování vchodů a znemožnění práce stávkokazům.

q.v: Esencialmente, no se trata de otra cosa que de dirigir cierta conexión hacia distintos servidores de forma cifrada consiguiendo que cada uno de ellos sólo sepa de dónde le ha llegado la conexión y a dónde la envía, pero de ninguna forma de dónde llegó al servidor que se la envía o a dónde la mandará aquel a quien la dirige.
q.e: Essentially, it is nothing more than routing a given connection through different servers in encrypted form, so that each of them knows only where the connection came from and where it sends it, but in no way where it came from before reaching the server that sends it or where the recipient to whom it directs it will send it.

q.e: An attempt that all those who care about this city—who every day, in neighborhoods, on the streets, in schools, universities, and workplaces, experience the hardships of the economic and social crisis, but resist, organize themselves, and create solidarity initiatives, considering differences, integration, and exchange a source of enrichment rather than a bogeyman to be waved about to conceal the real responsibilities of those who continue to unleash the crisis and wars south of the Mediterranean—want and must prevent.

q.e: It is time to attack them and sweep them all away, not in order to study or work under more dignified conditions, but to sweep oppression, inequality, and boredom from our lives. Let us put an end to school, work, and the world that needs them.

q.v: Lo que necesitamos es autoorganizarnos en nuestros trabajos, más mujeres anarcosindicalistas, que haya sororidad entre obreras, conspirar juntas para emplear el boicot, huelga y sabotaje haciendo que readmitan a nuestras compas despedidas
q.e: What we need is to self-organize in our workplaces; more anarcho-syndicalist women; solidarity among women workers; and to conspire together to use boycott, strike, and sabotage to make them reinstate our fired comrades.

An attempted eviction against us will involve a great deal of equipment and cops, which first have to be brought in. This logistical operation must be disrupted and destroyed.

blogs.sum: Czech-language anarchist radical counter-information blog that republishes reports and statements on imprisoned anarchists, anti-repression cases, solidarity actions, and anti-capitalist/anarchist critiques. q.v: A teď tedy k otázce jak správně auto zapálit. Potřebovat budeš petlahev (1,5l) naplněnou z poloviny benzínem a z poloviny motorovým olejem.
q.e: And now to the question of how to properly set a car on fire. You will need a plastic bottle (1.5 L) filled half with gasoline and half with motor oil.

q.v: Do láhve je potřeba nalít benzín a motorový olej (v poměru 1:1). Benzín zajistí rychlou vznětlivost. Motorový olej zvyšuje dobu hoření a zajistí přilnutí k povrchu.
q.e: It is necessary to pour gasoline and motor oil into the bottle (in a 1:1 ratio). Gasoline ensures rapid flammability. Motor oil increases the burning time and ensures adhesion to the surface.

q.v: Budík zapneme až těsně před umístěním na místo, které chceme zapálit. Načasovat ho můžeme na 1 minutu až hodinu. Jakmile dlouhá ručička dojde na dvanácku ciferníku, plech ve tvaru “L” se dotkne hřebíku. Tím se spojí elekrický obvod, který rožhaví vlákno žárovky.
q.e: We switch on the alarm clock only just before placing it at the location we want to set on fire. We can set it for between one minute and one hour. Once the long hand reaches twelve on the dial, the L-shaped piece of sheet metal touches the nail. This closes the electrical circuit, which heats the bulb filament.

q.v: Policejní represe proti anarchistům živí náš vztek. Jsou impulzem pro další útoky na policejní techniku.
q.e: Police repression against anarchists feeds our anger. It is an impulse for further attacks on police equipment.

Finnish radical anti-capitalist protest-organizing blog for the 6 December 2013 Kiakkovierasjuhlat event in Tampere. It mobilized participants against nationalist/state celebrations and class inequality, published a precise assembly time and place, distributed protest materials, gave police-arrest response guidance, and coordinated legal support for detainees after the event.

q.v: Jos näet kotijoukkueen pelaajaa vietävän jäähylle ohranan toimesta, auta heti piirittämällä ja painostamalla kidnappaajaa!
q.e: If you see a home-team player being taken to the penalty box by the cops, immediately help by encircling and pressuring the kidnapper!

q.v: Joissakin tilanteissa joudumme blokkaamaan presidentin joukkoja tehden tilaa kiekottomille pelaajille, toisissa taas ajamaan päin tiiviinä massana.
q.e: In some situations we have to block the president's forces, making room for players without the puck; in others, drive into them as a compact mass.

q.v: Jos näet, että poliisi on kiinniottamassa jotakuta, koita kerätä ihmisiä ympäriltäsi ja auta kerääntymällä poliisin ympärille.
q.e: If you see that the police are arresting someone, try to gather people around you and help by gathering around the police.

q.v: Kakkua päin Salen bläsii ja solidaarisuutta työläisille, työttömille, köyhille, prekaareille, opiskelijoille, siirtolaisille, mamuille, maailmankansalaisille, asunnottomille, maattomille alkuperäiskansoille, kynnyksiin ja lasikattoihin juuttuville, pakkosteriloiduille, kriminalisoiduille, syrjäytetyille, terapoiduille, laitostetuille ja loppuun palaneille Stadin ringettejengiltä.
q.e: Cake in Sale’s face, and solidarity with workers, the unemployed, the poor, precarious people, students, migrants, immigrants, world citizens, homeless people, landless Indigenous peoples, those stuck at thresholds and beneath glass ceilings, the forcibly sterilized, criminalized, marginalized, therapized, institutionalized, and burned out—from the Helsinki ringette gang.

q.v: Oikein ajoitetuilla pistohyökkäyksillä, harhautuksilla ja yhteistyöllä voimme iskeä presidentin joukkojen heikkoon kohtaan, ja edetä kohti Helsingin herrojen summuiden helppoheikkien kekkereitä ja katulätkäareenaa.
q.e: With properly timed thrust attacks, feints, and cooperation, we can strike at the weak point of the president’s forces and advance toward the festivities of Helsinki’s gentlemen’s shadowy charlatans and the street-hockey arena.

q.v: Seperti halnya tuntutan pada negara, poster-poster gratis ini suatu hari akan berubah kaca yang pecah, atau pintu yang rusak, atau bentuk kemarahan apapun yang bisa kita bayangkan.
q.e: Like demands made of the state, these free posters will one day turn into broken glass, or damaged doors, or whatever form of anger we can imagine.

q.v: jika mekanisme pengadilan Negara tidak dapat menjatuhkan hukuman yang setimpal dan memberikan keadilan, maka hukuman sosial yang pantas atas pembunuhan ratusan orang dan pengadilan yang korup adalah: pemberontakan sosial.
q.e: If the State's judicial mechanism cannot impose a commensurate punishment and provide justice, then the appropriate social punishment for the murder of hundreds of people and a corrupt court is: social rebellion.

q.e: The only way out lies in an organized and independent struggle capable of undertaking solidarity actions with the revolts inside the CIEs until their closure, and opposition to attempts at expulsion and deportation, extending to schools, workplaces, and neighborhoods.

blogs.sum: Italian radical-left collective blog publishing Marxist/anti-capitalist analysis and anti-war material, including notes from a public assembly on opposing prospective wars in Syria and Iran. It frames war, imperialism, exploitation, and proletarian struggle as interconnected.

q.v: Alla violenza legalizzata dello stato che, per imporre gli interessi di pochi, ha usato candelotti lacrimogeni (pesanti e bollenti) sparati ad altezza uomo (che hanno privato di un occhio anche un nostro compagno padovano), manganelli, le pietre dal cavalcavia dell’autostrada e le ruspe, molti manifestanti hanno opposto resistenza con quanto il bosco forniva loro.
q.e: Against the legalized violence of the state which, in order to impose the interests of a few, used tear-gas canisters (heavy and burning hot) fired at person-height (which also caused one of our comrades from Padua to lose an eye), batons, stones from the motorway overpass, and bulldozers, many demonstrators resisted with what the forest provided them.

q.v: Mercoledì 21 alle 18.30 nella Baracca Autogestita, si terrà un’assemblea pubblica per discutere, confrontarsi e provare a pianificare azioni comuni tra chi prova a resistere e rispondere a tutto questo senza passare per burocrazie sindacali e partitiche sempre più compromesse.
q.e: On Wednesday the 21st at 18:30 at the Baracca Autogestita, a public assembly will be held to discuss, compare views, and try to plan common actions among those attempting to resist and respond to all this without going through union and party bureaucracies that are increasingly compromised.

q.v: Per discutere e riflettere Per condividere le esperienze Per coordinare le lotte Per pianificare appuntamenti ed iniziative comuni ASSEMBLEA PUBBLICA CONTRO GLI ESPROPRI
q.e: To discuss and reflect; to share experiences; to coordinate struggles; to plan common events and initiatives. PUBLIC ASSEMBLY AGAINST EXPROPRIATIONS.

q.v: Verso il Primo Maggio Assemblea pubblica 18 aprile @ Baracca Autogestita PER COSTRUIRE UNA PIAZZA AUTORGANIZZATA PER IL 1° MAGGIO, CHE DIA IL SENSO ORIGINARIO A QUESTA DATA E LA SOTTRAGGA ALLA KERMESSE MEDIATICA
q.e: Toward May Day: public assembly, April 18 at Baracca Autogestita, TO BUILD A SELF-ORGANIZED SQUARE FOR MAY 1ST, WHICH GIVES THIS DATE ITS ORIGINAL MEANING AND REMOVES IT FROM THE MEDIA KERMESSE.

q.v: Questo primo maggio non è né l’ultimo né il primo giorno della nostra lotta, speriamo sia, come speriamo sempre, il giorno in cui le porte delle nostre case si apriranno, per incontrarci. Ci vediamo in piazza.
q.e: This May Day is neither the last nor the first day of our struggle; we hope it will be, as we always hope, the day when the doors of our homes open so that we can meet each other. See you in the square.

q.v: Dès maintenant, et surtout à partir de la mi-juin, les permis d’urbanisme et d’environnement peuvent être délivrés par la Région de Bxl-Capitale et les travaux de construction pourront officiellement commencer sur le terrain du Keelbeek (Bruxelles-Haren). On a besoin de plus de monde sur place pour maintenir une vigilance constante, participer aux permanences tous les matins et résister / ralentir le début des travaux.
q.e: From now on, and especially starting in mid-June, urban-planning and environmental permits may be issued by the Brussels-Capital Region and construction work may officially begin on the Keelbeek site (Brussels-Haren). We need more people on site to maintain constant vigilance, take part in the morning shifts, and resist / slow the start of the work.

blogs.sum: German-language local radical anti-fascist blog focused on countering NPD and Pro Deutschland electoral-tour appearances in the Rhine-Neckar region. q.v: Wir rufen dazu auf, sich den Nazis mit allen geeigneten Mitteln in den Weg zu stellen.
q.e: We call on people to stand in the Nazis’ way using all suitable means.

q.v: Lasst uns entschlossen, kämpferisch und kreativ die Bundeswehr so lang nerven, blockieren und sabotieren, bis sie sich verzieht.
q.e: Let us resolutely, combatively, and creatively annoy, block, and sabotage the Bundeswehr until it leaves.

q.v: Deshalb rufen wir am 22.06.13 um 13 Uhr dazu auf, die Veranstaltung am Willy-Brand-Platz entschlossen und kämpferisch zu stören!
q.e: Therefore, we call on people on 22 June 2013 at 1 p.m. to resolutely and militantly disrupt the event at Willy-Brandt-Platz!

q.v: Und wie im Februar, als die Nazis ebenfalls dort aufmarschieren wollten, liegt es auch jetzt wieder an uns, die Faschisten ungehört zum Rückzug zu zwingen.
q.e: And as in February, when the Nazis likewise wanted to march there, it is once again up to us to force the fascists to retreat unheard.

q.v: Voilà l’ambition d’une telle initiative: se réunir, discuter ensemble de ce qu’il est opportun de faire, organiser des manifs sur Bordeaux, échanger textes, affiches, aller coller, voir comment bouger ensemble dans les grosses dates programmées ailleurs en France, s’organiser.
q.e: This is the aim of such an initiative: to get together, discuss what it would be appropriate to do, organize demonstrations in Bordeaux, exchange texts and posters, go and put up posters, see how to act together around the major dates planned elsewhere in France, and organize ourselves.

Spanish-language blog containing revolutionary political text on Latin American urban guerrilla strategy, class alliances, and armed struggle against military dictatorships and imperialism. q.v: Al atacar, es preciso hacerlo más bien pronto que tarde; pues hay más probabilidades de triunfo en el primer caso que en el segundo, porque así se asegura el factor sorpresa que tiene suma importancia en la psicología de la guerra.
q.e: When attacking, it is necessary to do so sooner rather than later; for there are greater probabilities of success in the first case than in the second, because this ensures the element of surprise, which is highly important in the psychology of war.

q.v: A tal propósito, hay que dejar numerosos guerrilleros, camuflados como campesinos en la retaguardia enemiga, para hostigar al adversario, lograr información y levantar la moral revolucionaria en territorio enemigo.
q.e: For this purpose, numerous guerrillas, disguised as peasants, must be left in the enemy’s rear in order to harass the adversary, obtain information, and raise revolutionary morale in enemy territory.

q.v: S’ils nous répriment durement lorsque nous souhaitons exprimer les souffrances quotidiennes qu’ils nous imposent, alors un jour ils auront à subir la souffrance qu’eux seuls ont infligée à l’immense majorité d’entre nous.
q.e: If they harshly repress us when we wish to express the daily suffering they impose on us, then one day they will have to endure the suffering that they alone have inflicted on the vast majority of us.

q.v: C’est hélas dans le désespoir et la précipitation que les gens agissent, et cela mène bien souvent à des actes sanglants à l’instar de ceux d’Emile Henry, d’Auguste Vaillant, de Théodule Meunier, Rinaldi ou encore de Ravachol.
q.e: Unfortunately, it is in despair and haste that people act, and this very often leads to bloody acts like those of Émile Henry, Auguste Vaillant, Théodule Meunier, Rinaldi, or Ravachol.

It appears primarily ideological and personal rather than a formal group platform, but remains movement-relevant anarchist content.

q.v: Un embrasement féroce du quotidien tel celui qui enflamme actuellement les Etats-Unis suite au meurtre glaçant de George Floyd par des policiers, serait la moindre des choses partout, mais ce ne sera pas suffisant.
q.e: A fierce conflagration of everyday life like the one currently setting the United States aflame following the chilling murder of George Floyd by police officers would be the least that should happen everywhere, but it would not be sufficient.

q.v: Aussi, et à l’heure où l’étranglement de toute expression contestataire s’apprête à devenir sérieusement dictatorial 4, il faut affirmer la nécessité absolue que se construise un vaste mouvement de résistance conscient des enjeux, et comptant des personnes et des groupes de personnes prêts à faire le nécessaire pour enrayer autant que possible ce déferlement de catastrophes.
q.e: Thus, at a time when the strangling of all dissenting expression is about to become seriously dictatorial, it is necessary to affirm the absolute need for a vast resistance movement aware of what is at stake, and including people and groups of people ready to do what is necessary to halt, as far as possible, this onslaught of catastrophes.

q.v: On voyait des ministres pendus à leurs fenêtres; des généraux au peloton, triturés par les balles; des prêtres pourléchés par des langues infernales, dans l’incendie généralisé. Pas de pitié, par de décor ni de spectacle
q.e: There were ministers hanging from their windows; generals before the firing squad, mangled by bullets; priests licked all over by infernal tongues, amid the general conflagration. No pity, no décor, no spectacle.

q.v: Au moins avant rêvais-je avec violence, de bastons générales sur le lieu de travail, d’incendies criminels du lieu de travail, de fracassements complets et absolus du lieu de travail, du meurtre des employeurs sur le lieu de travail.
q.e: At least, I used to dream violently: of general brawls at the workplace, of arson at the workplace, of the complete and absolute smashing-up of the workplace, of murdering employers at the workplace.

q.v: Lorsque l’aliénation est à ce point critique, son sabotage par tous les moyens possibles et réalisables devient, pour paraphraser cette fameuse plaisanterie hypocrite, le plu
q.e: When alienation reaches such a critical point, sabotaging it by every possible and practicable means becomes, to paraphrase that famous hypocritical joke, the most...

q.v: Di dalam stasiun transformator, kabel-kabel tersebut menjulur dari tanah (dilapisi selubung isolasi) dan menjulang ke tiang-tiang. Di sinilah kami dapat membakarnya tanpa risiko besar, menyebabkan korsleting dan memutus pasokan listrik.
q.e: Inside the transformer station, the cables emerge from the ground (covered in insulating sheathing) and rise up to the poles. This is where we could burn them without great risk, causing a short circuit and cutting off the electricity supply.

q.v: [NAME: private auto-shop owner]! You, your [WORKPLACE: auto repair business], and your Nazi wife with messy hair and terrible bangs are not safe in Portland. We are always watching, and we are everywhere.

Biarkan mereka ingat dan tahu bahwa kami juga dapat melacak mereka di rumah mereka, di lingkungan mereka, di tempat kerja mereka, dan bahwa mereka tidak benar-benar aman di mana pun dengan memilih untuk melayani sistem ini.
q.e: Let them remember and know that we can also track them at their homes, in their neighborhoods, at their workplaces, and that they are not truly safe anywhere by choosing to serve this system.

q.v: Serangan pembakaran terhadap rumahnya hanyalah peringatan. Kami mengetahui kehidupan sehari-harinya dengan baik, dan tergantung pada tindakan masa depannya, ia akan menjadi target yang layak.
q.e: The arson attack on his home was only a warning. We know his daily life well, and depending on his future actions, he will become a worthy target.

q.v: Oleh karena itu, kami menyerukan serangan berkelanjutan terhadap Thales dan perusahaan-perusahaan lain yang terlibat dalam genosida, serta Eiffage dan semua subkontraktornya yang terlibat dalam pembangunan Helios 2. So, I’ve decided to learn how to fight. It’s imperative that I have some idea of how to defend myself against the chaotic and hard to predict violence of jail.

blogs.sum: French-language blog documenting a 1,000 km march across western France toward COP21, linking climate protest with the Notre-Dame-des-Landes (NDDL/ZAD) movement. Posts recount local outreach, anti-militarist gatherings, and public noise demonstrations while opposing restrictions on protest.

q.v: Pour qu’émergent des possibles, il s’agit de bloquer concrètement dès maintenant l’avancée de leurs projets d’aéroports et de lignes à grande vitesse, l’extraction des minerais et gaz de schistes, l’enfouissement vénéneux des déchêts nucléaires, la poussée de l’agro-industrie et l’éclosion incessante des center parcs et des hypermarchés…
q.e: For possibilities to emerge, it is necessary to concretely block, starting now, the advance of their airport and high-speed rail projects, the extraction of minerals and shale gas, the poisonous burial of nuclear waste, the expansion of agro-industry, and the incessant emergence of Center Parcs and hypermarkets…

q.v: Soyez donc certain que le premier coup de pelleteuse signifierait l’ouverture de la plus grande ZAD de France.
q.e: So be certain that the first excavator scoop would mean the opening of the largest ZAD in France.

q.v: Nous le ferons en occupant et en bloquant physiquement les chantiers, comme l’on fait nos camarades à Roybon, au Testet, à Agen, à Notre dame des Landes et dans bien d’autres lieux.
q.e: We will do so by occupying and physically blocking construction sites, as our comrades did at Roybon, Le Testet, Agen, Notre-Dame-des-Landes, and in many other places.

q.v: nous devrons affirmer notre détermination à ne pas céder aux interdictions de manifester, et peut être inventer avec cette masse justement de nouvelles formes de manifestation.
q.e: We will have to affirm our determination not to yield to bans on demonstrating, and perhaps invent new forms of demonstration precisely with this mass of people.

ne: Ce n’est pas une convergence mais une Fusion de nos marches !

blogs.sum: Italian-language collective health-politics blog publishing a COVID-era critique of healthcare privatization, austerity, and the prioritization of industrial production over workers’ health. blogs.sum: Italian blog for Malerbe, a self-production collective involved in the ResPublica self-managed socio-cultural space in Alghero. It publicizes free political film screenings, assemblies, solidarity-oriented cultural events, and discussions connecting local organizing with anti-capitalist urban, housing, and anti-austerity struggles internationally.

q.v: E poi succede che 76 famiglie che non hanno una casa quel palazzo se lo prendono, perchè la casa è un diritto. E dai diritti non si prescinde.
q.e: And then it happens that 76 families who do not have a home take that building, because housing is a right. And rights are non-negotiable.

blogs.sum: French-language radical counter-information blog reposting militant political texts, including queer solidarity writing and an insurrectionary defense of Black Bloc tactics connected to the Notre-Dame-des-Landes struggle. The material explicitly normalizes property destruction and violence against police as part of revolutionary struggle.

q.v: « Casser du flic», soit dit en passant, cela ne signifie pas vouloir concurrencer la police sur le plan militaire, mais simplement qu’il est naturel de faire la preuve, en acte que, parmi toutes les possibilités existentielles, certaines sont intolérables. Il faut donc, pavé en main, en tenir informés les premiers concernés.
q.e: “Smashing cops,” incidentally, does not mean wanting to compete with the police on the military level, but simply that it is natural to demonstrate, through action, that among all possible ways of existing, some are intolerable. It is therefore necessary, paving stone in hand, to make this known to those directly concerned.

q.v: Quand ça leur revient dans la gueule c’est bien fait. De tout de manière des types qu’acceptent d’enfermer et de surveiller des gens pour un peu de thune ne méritent pas mieux.
q.e: When it comes back in their faces, they deserve it. In any case, people who agree to lock up and watch other people for a bit of money deserve no better.

Italian radical-left/anarchist counter-information blog focused on squat evictions, occupied-house defense, anti-fascist mobilization, and anti-repression in Turin, while also reposting material from other Italian cities. It documents and endorses resistance around squats such as Velena, Boccia, and Barocchio.

ne: Suite à une reprise brève des permanances en septembre et octobre, dans le local de Quartier libre, nous nous rejouissions de l’engouement pour les permanances en mixité choisie (sans mec cis) et l’emprunts des livres feministes… nous aurions bien continué ainsi, si nous n’avions pas dû reconfiner les permanances, comme le reste de nos vies. Novembre et décembre ont donc été « en ligne » mais le principe d’arpentage en visio avait été bien apprécié au printemps, alors on a remis ça ! Et quelle bonne idée ! Trois arpentages, avec une dizaine de participant.e.s à chaque fois. Nous avons arpenté : « Le capitalisme patriarcal » de Silvia Federici sur la construction et l’analyse de la société occidentale sexiste et machiste ; « Se défendre » de Elsa Dorlin : un gros morceau ! Très complet sur l’histoires des mouvements de resistance, d’autodetermination et d’autodefense féministe et décoloniale. Un volume un peu trop conséquent pour un arpentage de 3 heures, mais ça nous a permis de comprendre en substance le contenu de l’ouvrage et nous a encouragé à y revenir pour approfondir nos lectures ! « Et Je suis un monstre qui vous parle » de Paul B Preciado, qui nous a permis d’aborder la transphobie, de parler de psychanalyse, de noter les imprécisions et maladresses de vocabulaire de notre société cisnormative. L’arpentage est un outil d’éducation populaire que nous apprécions et nous avons été enchanté.e.s de voir de nouvelles personnes rejoindre ces ateliers et s’enthousiasmer du potentiel de cet outil. Le mode « numérique » et à distance de ces ateliers n’est pas l’idéal pour tisser des liens entre nous. Les outils de visio ont leurs limites, mais c’était tout de même très chouette de vivre ces moments de lecture collective, de restitution et d’échange pendant des soirées dédiées. Cela nous donne le pouvoir de produire un savoir collectif de façon simple et non académique ou universitaire. Même si relire le livre en entier, c’est bien aussi ! Nous avons hâte de pouvoir proposer d’autres ateliers autour de la même table… L’atelier d’écriture prévu en novembre sera proposé de nouveau dès que possible. Nous avons aussi proposé des emprunts en « livraison à domicile », qui ont été bien appréciés ! Ce qui a même encouragé certaines adhérentes à prêter leurs livres perso au fond de la bibli, merci ! En bref, malgré les chamboulements, l’année n’a pas trop mal commencé pour Nanara, et on a hâte de poursuivre avec 2021 et plein d’envies à partager. Le féminisme ne se confine pas ! Merci à toustes de faire vivre Nanara, vivement la suite, ensemble ! Bisous, belle fin d’année et à très vite

q.v: Per questo abbiamo deciso di bloccare le obliteratrici della metro B nelle stazioni Marconi, San Paolo e Garbatella così da rendere libero l’accesso alla metropolitana.
q.e: For this reason, we decided to block the ticket validators on Metro B at the Marconi, San Paolo, and Garbatella stations in order to make access to the metro free.

q.v: Le lotte dei lavoratori o le occupazioni di spazi abbandonati vengono criminalizzate per la loro carica di conflittualità ma per noi sono esperienze che dovrebbero moltiplicarsi nei quartieri e nei luoghi di lavoro
q.e: Workers’ struggles or occupations of abandoned spaces are criminalized for their conflictual character, but for us they are experiences that should multiply in neighborhoods and workplaces.

q.v: NON PAGARE IL BIGLIETTO E’ UNA FORMA DI RIAPPROPRIAZIONE DI QUALCOSA CHE CI APPARTIENE, UN ATTO POLITICO BEN CHIARO.
q.e: Not paying the ticket is a form of reclaiming something that belongs to us, a very clear political act.

q.v: Credendo che l’azione diretta sia una risposta ben più efficace delle lamentazioni ‘sindacali’ (in questo caso come in tanti altri), segnaliamo a tutti come i chip rfid si disattivino abbastanza facilmente, soprattutto quelli dell’arretrato modello previsto per gli animali.
q.e: Believing that direct action is a far more effective response than ‘trade-union’ complaints (in this case as in many others), we point out to everyone that RFID chips can be deactivated fairly easily, especially those of the outdated model intended for animals.

q.v: Studiarle, capirne meccanismi e schemi – nonché dotarsi degli strumenti analitici necessari per riconoscere un’espulsione all’interno di un aeroporto o, addirittura, di un aereo – è necessario con il fine di trovare i punti di attacco
q.e: Studying them, understanding their mechanisms and patterns—and equipping oneself with the analytical tools necessary to recognize an expulsion inside an airport or even on an airplane—is necessary in order to find points of attack.

One can obtain them from mines, quarries, or lumber operations, and usually with little hassle since (1) the explosives are kept away from workers for safety reasons, and (2) they are usually secured by a single padlock which may or may not be locked.

It should also be pointed out that it requires approximately 4 pounds of explosives per square foot to take down concrete or cinderblock structures, such as courthouses or schools or embassies or… bridges. That would be 1.6 pounds of C4 per square foot.

q.v: Desde o princípio as organizações indígenas, camponesas e proletárias se valeram dos autênticos métodos de ação direta, tais como as greves, bloqueios de estradas, marchas, e acumulando forças para a deflagração de uma greve geral por tempo indeterminado e do uso da violência política e da autodefesa, configurando assim uma situação insurrecional na Bolívia.
q.e: From the beginning, the Indigenous, peasant, and proletarian organizations have made use of authentic methods of direct action, such as strikes, road blockades, and marches, while accumulating forces for the launch of an indefinite general strike and for the use of political violence and self-defense, thus creating an insurrectional situation in Bolivia.

q.v: Diante disso, uma greve geral combativa seria uma justa e salutar resposta.
q.e: In light of this, a combative general strike would be a just and salutary response.

q.v: Dans ce contexte, nous voulons dire que nous comprenons le possible recours au sabotage par des groupes qui n’ont pas d’autres choix, là où iels vivent, lorsque cela fait des décennies que les multinationales et leurs activités meurtrières détruisent irrémédiablement la nature et restent à jamais impunies.
q.e: In this context, we want to say that we understand the possible recourse to sabotage by groups that have no other choice where they live, when multinational corporations and their deadly activities have been irreversibly destroying nature for decades and remain forever unpunished.

q.v: En effet, il est étrange de parler de violence quand on imagine un sucre dans un moteur, alors même que des multinationales ont recours quotidiennement au sabotage continu de la planète sans être jamais reconsidérées, punies ou régulées par la loi (vu l’échec de dimanche).
q.e: Indeed, it is strange to speak of violence when one imagines putting sugar in an engine, while multinationals engage daily in the ongoing sabotage of the planet without ever being challenged, punished, or regulated by law (given Sunday’s failure).

q.v: l’attacco può e deve essere portato anche contro chi cerca di fermare un atto distruttivo o un singolo individuo nelle sue scelte individuali-che sia il cittadino ben pensate o lo sbirro
q.e: The attack can and must also be directed against whoever tries to stop a destructive act or an individual in their individual choices—whether it is the respectable citizen or the cop.

q.v: Sapere che indomiti individui e compagni fanno saltare in aria assieme a banche, corti, galere, uffici-gabbie, agenzie, scuole e via dicendo, la statica pace sociale che offre una vita artificiale fatta di cemento e di noia, o che, incuranti delle conseguenze, decidono di azzoppare un pezzo di merda, è qualcosa che fa ribollire nelle mie vene il fuoco della nuova anarchia
q.e: Knowing that untamed individuals and comrades blow up, along with banks, courts, prisons, cage-offices, agencies, schools, and so on, the static social peace that offers an artificial life made of concrete and boredom, or that, heedless of the consequences, they decide to cripple a piece of shit, is something that makes the fire of the new anarchy boil in my veins.

q.v: Così, l’FLT/ELF rivendica come parte della lotta contro l’attuale rete di istituzioni sistematizzate di dominazione-civilizzazione, il congegno esploso il 20 agosto del 2012 alla proprietà del Consiglio Messicano di Scienza e Tecnologia – COMECyT- che si trova a Toluca, provocando danni materiali al portone dell’entrata dell’edificio.
q.e: Thus, the FLT/ELF claims responsibility, as part of the struggle against the current network of systematized institutions of domination-civilization, for the device that exploded on 20 August 2012 at the premises of the Mexican Council of Science and Technology—COMECyT—in Toluca, causing material damage to the building’s entrance gate.

q.v: Like a vengeful wraith, we placed our enchanted incendiary devises in the cables connecting the tower to the leviathanic network. We howled to the moon when we lit the fuses and cursed the civilisation for all eternity.

cutter ou poinçon sur le flanc du pneu (pas sur le dessus il y a de la feraille) et le tour est joué! (attention ça peut prendre quelques coups et péter fort, le poinçon fait moins de bruit apparement)

q.v: Abbiamo scelto di rispondere con l’azione diretta a ciò che opprime per allargare le prospettive del conflitto e combattere le logiche del recupero riformista e della mediazione politica dell’”intervento”. Auspichiamo ad una crescita delle lotte nella continuità dell’attacco.
q.e: We chose to respond through direct action to that which oppresses us, in order to broaden the prospects of conflict and fight the logic of reformist recuperation and the political mediation of “intervention.” We hope for the growth of struggles in the continuity of the attack.

q.v: Gardons donc nos saines méfiances envers tout ce qui pourrait ressembler à de l’autorité mais ne nous empêchons pas de penser à la façon dont nous pourrions nous organiser de manière plus large: des appels à des campagnes d’attaques, des partages de savoirs et pratiques sur papiers, des textes de débats entre nous, certaines rencontres informelles en réfléchissant grandement à la sécurité, des petits groupes de réflexion plutôt que des grosses AG, favoriser la rencontre d’un contact représentant d’autres gens plutôt qu’un processus à plus nombreuses, …
q.e: Let us therefore keep our healthy distrust of anything that might resemble authority, but let us not stop ourselves from thinking about how we could organize more broadly: calls for attack campaigns, sharing knowledge and practices in writing, debate texts among ourselves, certain informal meetings with great attention to security, small discussion groups rather than large general assemblies, favoring a meeting with one contact representing other people rather than a process involving more people, …

q.v: È stata una volontà umana, rabbiosa e determinata, ad aver piazzato tre inneschi in tre punti diversi all’interno dell’edificio.
q.e: It was a human will, angry and determined, that placed three incendiary devices at three different points inside the building.

q.e: We propose continuing to make Soulèvements de la Terre visible in public space, in our territories around the world: in front of social centres, through writing on walls, within our struggles and territories, through banners and celebrations, vigils and direct actions, and any other action suited to our contexts.

q.v:
Mit Benzin und Autoreifen, nachts n’ Feuerchen entfachen
Im beschaulichen Mariendorf im dunklen angeschlichen
Der Zaun schnell aufgeknabbert und den Kameras gewichen
Wir kommen stets zu später Stund, die Secus sind am pennen
Der Baustrom und das Trafohaus – schon lichterloh am brennen!
q.e: With gasoline and car tires, light a little fire at night / crept up in the dark in tranquil Mariendorf / quickly gnawed through the fence and avoided the cameras / we always come at a late hour, the security guards are sleeping / the construction power supply and transformer house—already blazing brightly!

q.v: Im Inneren des Umspannwerks kommen die Kabel aus dem Boden (isoliert in Ummantelungen) und werden auf die Masten geführt. Dort ist es möglich, sie ohne großes Risiko in Brand zu setzen, wodurch ein Kurzschluss verursacht und der Strom abgeschaltet wird.
q.e: Inside the substation, the cables come out of the ground (insulated in sheaths) and are led to the poles. There it is possible to set them on fire without much risk, thereby causing a short circuit and cutting off the power.

q.v: Wir hatten 9 Liter Grillanzünder in 18 0,5-Liter Plastikflaschen abgefüllt und in einen großen Kochtopf gestellt. Ein pyrotechnischer Zünder kam statt eines elektronischen zum Einsatz, um die Gefahr einer Fehlzündung durch die starken elektromagnetischen Felder des Transformators zu vermeiden.
q.e: We had filled 9 liters of barbecue lighter fluid into 18 0.5-liter plastic bottles and placed them in a large cooking pot. A pyrotechnic igniter was used instead of an electronic one in order to avoid the risk of a misfire caused by the transformer's strong electromagnetic fields.

q.v: Wenn du in einer Firma oder in der Forschung arbeitest und dort auch mit Rüstung und Militär kooperiert wird – veröffentliche diese Informationen, verzögere die Abläufe und beschädige Produktion, verweigere die Arbeit.
q.e: If you work in a company or in research and it also cooperates with the arms industry and the military, publish this information, delay operations and damage production; refuse to work.

q.v: Brandsätze wurden deponiert in einem großen Kabelschacht an der nordöstlichen Ecke der Wupperbrücke und auf halbem Weg zwischen Unterführung und Funkmast in einem schmaleren Schacht.
q.e: Incendiary devices were placed in a large cable shaft at the northeastern corner of the Wupper Bridge and halfway between the underpass and radio mast in a narrower shaft.

q.v: In questo momento solidali si stanno raggruppando sotto alle mura del lager di Gradisca per portare solidarietà ai reclusi: invitiamo tutte e tutti a raggiungere lo spiazzo davanti all’ex caserma Polonio per mostrare la nostra rabbia e la vicinanza a chi è recluso in questa galera etnica.

q.v: Lanciamo un appello a scendere in strada, nei nostri rioni, anche in violazione delle misure, ma sempre seguendo il principio di cautela per l’altrui e la nostra salute. E ognuno secondo le sua disponibilità. Alle ore 11:00 del 25 aprile.
q.e: We issue a call to take to the streets, in our neighborhoods, even in violation of the measures, while always following the principle of caution for others’ health and our own. And each according to their availability. At 11:00 a.m. on April 25.

q.v: Adesso il peggio non è passato e la nostra rabbia deve tornare con gli interessi tutto quello che abbiamo patito. Siamo in guerra e il nemico è di classe: è Confindustria, sono i padroni e i loro terminali politici. Devono pagare tutto e pagare caro.
q.e: Now the worst is not over, and our anger must make them repay, with interest, everything we have suffered. We are at war, and the enemy is a class enemy: it is Confindustria, the bosses, and their political operatives. They must pay for everything, and pay dearly.

q.v: Essa non è il titolo di una nuova scienza social-rivoluzionaria. E’ il nome che nel nostro movimento si è convenuto assegnare per comodità del discorso, alla convergenza di tutte quelle pratiche rivoluzionarie che uscendo dal terreno della legalità attaccano direttamente con mezzi esplosivi – dinamite,plastico,tritolo – tutte le istituzioni attuali e con le armi in pugno attentano ai loro rappresentanti e vari servitori
q.e: It is not the title of a new social-revolutionary science. It is the name that, in our movement, has conventionally been assigned, for convenience of discussion, to the convergence of all those revolutionary practices which, leaving the terrain of legality, directly attack all current institutions with explosive means—dynamite, plastique, TNT—and, weapons in hand, attack their representatives and various servants.

q.v: Affermiamo la nostra solidarietà con gli imputati, e soprattutto con il gesto di cui sono accusati, che ricordiamo, è un atto di vita quotidiana, un atto necessario per tutti coloro che desiderano la libertà
q.e: We affirm our solidarity with the defendants, and above all with the act of which they are accused, which, we recall, is an act of everyday life, an act necessary for all those who desire freedom.

q.v: alla violenza indiscriminata degli Stati ci opporremo con la violenza discriminata contro i responsabili di tutto ciò.
q.e: To the indiscriminate violence of the States, we will respond with targeted violence against those responsible for all this.

q.v: Quindi tutto questo ci rende chiaro dove colpire! Attaccare nello specifico il razzismo e lo sfruttamento. Colpire lo stato, il capitale i suoi responsabili.
q.e: So all this makes clear to us where to strike! Specifically, to attack racism and exploitation. To strike the state, capital, and those responsible for them.

q.v: Le azioni ELF non hanno un senso solamente distruttivo ma anche educativo. Ogni fiamma che si innalza al cielo è stimolo alla discussione, alla conoscenza di lotte che da tempo si combattono dietro le quinte.
q.e: ELF actions do not have a merely destructive purpose, but an educational one as well. Every flame that rises to the sky stimulates discussion and awareness of struggles that have long been fought behind the scenes.

q.v: Ma in compenso, gli atti “ irresponsabili” di quel momento sono precisamente da rivendicare per il seguito del movimento rivoluzionario del nostro tempo (anche se le circostanze li hanno limitati quasi tutti allo stadio distruttivo – l’esempio più conosciuto é l’insorto che dice al borghese sospetto, che afferma di non essersi mai occupato di politica: “ E’ proprio per questo che ti uccido”).
q.e: But, conversely, the “irresponsible” acts of that moment are precisely to be claimed for the continuation of the revolutionary movement of our time (even if circumstances limited almost all of them to the destructive stage—the best-known example is the insurgent who says to the suspicious bourgeois, who claims never to have concerned himself with politics: “That is precisely why I kill you”).

q.v: Con la penna o il pugnale, con la parola o l’esplosivo,verso un comune orizzonte: l’abbattimento dell’Autorità e la possibilità di una piena autodeterminazione individuale e sociale.

q.v: Und ist es nicht Selbstverteidigung bzw. die Verteidigung anderer, wenn Polizist*innen angegriffen werden, die mit aller Gewalt eine Politik und ein System schützen, die für den Tod von unzähligen Lebewesen verantwortlich sind?
q.e: And is it not self-defence, or the defence of others, when police officers are attacked who, by all means of violence, protect a policy and a system responsible for the deaths of countless living beings?

q.v: Zwischen der Meldung eines zivilen Aufklärers oder einer Gruppe, bis zur Umsetzung der befohlenen Reaktion, vergeht genau die Zeit, die wir brauchen um die Situation erneut zu verändern.
q.e: Between the report from a civilian scout or a group and the implementation of the ordered response, exactly the time passes that we need to change the situation again.

q.v: Jederzeit wäre es möglich sich in kleinen oder größeren Kreisen zu verschwören und die Jagdsaison auf Nazis zu eröffnen.
q.e: At any time, it would be possible to conspire in small or larger circles and open hunting season on Nazis.

q.v: Nach dem ersten Angriff war klar, dass die Bullen jetzt bei jeder Gelegenheit entschieden abgewiesen werden müssen, was auch bis zum Dorfplatz ganz gut funktionierte.
q.e: After the first attack, it was clear that the cops now had to be decisively repelled at every opportunity, which also worked quite well up to Dorfplatz.

q.v: Das sind Moment in denen Autorität in Frage gestellt wird und wir etwas offener Rache nehmen können, das Wesentliche zerstören was dieses System repräsentiert und am Laufen hält, randalieren und die Polizei angreifen.
q.e: These are moments when authority is called into question and we can take revenge somewhat more openly, destroy the essential things that represent and keep this system running, riot, and attack the police.

blogs.sum: Köln-based protest coalition mobilizing against the proposed North Rhine-Westphalia assembly law, framed as a threat to freedom of assembly and democratic rights. Posts provide demonstration announcements, collective travel logistics, protest preparation, press coverage, and a legal-support emergency contact for arrests.

q.v: Anlässlich der Anhörung des VersG vor dem Innenausschuss am 6.5 rufen wir die gesamte Kölner Zivilgesellschaft am Vorabend, dem 5.5, dazu auf, am landesweiten Protest teilzunehmen und um 18:00 nach einer kurzen Auftaktkundgebung am Neumarkt gemeinsam als Demonstrationszug durch die Straßen Kölns zu ziehen.
q.e: On the occasion of the hearing on the Assembly Act before the Interior Committee on 6 May, we call on all of Cologne civil society to take part in the statewide protest the evening before, on 5 May, and at 18:00, after a brief opening rally at Neumarkt, to march together through the streets of Cologne as a demonstration procession.

q.v: Le 20/21 Juillet week-end de résistance contre le projet de Surf Park de Saint Père en Retz (44): manif-occupation de la mairie vers le site du projet, concerts, implantation d’un potager, construction de cabanes pour occuper le site à durée indéterminée, animations, etc…
q.e: The July 20–21 weekend: a weekend of resistance against the Surf Park project in Saint-Père-en-Retz (44): a demonstration-occupation from the town hall to the project site, concerts, setting up a vegetable garden, building cabins to occupy the site indefinitely, activities, etc.

q.v: Nous ne pouvons laisser faire ce projet, il est urgent et nécessaire d’occuper le terrain et de montrer en nombre que nous ne voulons plus de leur monde de béton et de mort!
q.e: We cannot allow this project to go ahead; it is urgent and necessary to occupy the site and demonstrate, in large numbers, that we no longer want their world of concrete and death!

q.v: Ceci est également un appel à la future occupation du chantier du Surf Park, par le nombre nous parviendrons à faire tomber ce projet insensé et à préserver notre avenir commun.
q.e: This is also a call for the future occupation of the Surf Park construction site; through our numbers, we will manage to bring down this senseless project and preserve our common future.

blogs.sum: Italian local political collective in Treviso centered on the occupied/self-managed CSO Django (former Caserma Piave). It organizes assemblies, demonstrations, anti-eviction solidarity, cultural events, antifascist activity, and campaigns around urban development, environmental protection, policing, and repression of activists.

q.v: Noi non abbiamo lasciato passare nemmeno una settimana, e domenica pomeriggio ci siamo ritrovati all’ex provincia per colorare un po’ il nuovo muro firmato Gentilini, e aprirci un varco
q.e: We did not let even a week pass, and on Sunday afternoon we met at the former provincial building to add a bit of color to the new wall bearing Gentilini’s signature, and to open a way through.

q.v: ZTL Wake Up! ha liberato un altro spazio! L’edificio Ex IVA in via castellana 48D, venendo da treviso prima del passaggio a livello a destra.
q.e: ZTL Wake Up! has liberated another space! The former VAT building on Via Castellana 48D, coming from Treviso, before the level crossing on the right.

q.v: Oggi il Collettivo ZTL Wake Up ha liberato nuovamente l’ex Telecom abbattendo il muro che lo separava dalla città!
q.e: Today the ZTL Wake Up Collective once again liberated the former Telecom building by knocking down the wall that separated it from the city!

q.v: Non abbiamo più tempo da perdere per inseguire scuse e cavilli burocratici, abbiamo ancora molti lucchetti da rompere.
q.e: We no longer have time to waste chasing excuses and bureaucratic quibbles; we still have many locks to break.

q.v: Lo abbiamo fatto consapevoli di rompere sigilli, abbattere muri, sfondare porte e anche arrecare dei fastidi a qualcuno.
q.e: We did it aware that we were breaking seals, knocking down walls, forcing doors, and also causing inconvenience to someone.

blogs.sum: French radical ecological resistance and solidarity blog focused on opposition to the A69 motorway between Castres and Toulouse. It relays support campaigns for prosecuted and imprisoned activists, fundraising, and in-person solidarity events, framing the struggle through anarchist, anti-prison, queer, and anti-repression politics.

q.v: Dans nos coeurs, dans nos yeux et sur les engins: partout le feu.
q.e: In our hearts, in our eyes, and on the machinery: fire everywhere.

q.v: Dès maintenant, nous vous invitons à nous rejoindre avec le nécessaire de campement, des vêtements chauds, pas de téléphone perso et votre maxi deter. Si vous voulez grimper on vous formera au mieux, n’hésitez pas à prendre vos baudriers et longes si vous avez.
q.e: From now on, we invite you to join us with the necessary camping gear, warm clothing, no personal phone, and your maximum determination. If you want to climb, we will train you as best we can; do not hesitate to bring your harnesses and lanyards if you have them.

q.v: Mais l’extériorisation d’une colère légitime n’est pas la seule fonction de la destruction de matériel. Elle a également un intérêt très concret pour la lutte, d’abord car elle fait directement prendre du retard au chantier
q.e: But the expression of legitimate anger is not the only function of destroying equipment. It also has a very concrete benefit for the struggle, first because it directly delays the construction work.

q.v: Ainsi, bien que cela nécessite quelques dispositions logistiques et un paquet de courage car ça expose à une répression très intense, ce genre d’action utilise peu de ressources et permet de leur mettre des bâtons dans les routes sans conséquences graves.
q.e: Thus, although it requires some logistical preparations and a great deal of courage because it exposes one to very intense repression, this kind of action uses few resources and makes it possible to throw a wrench in their works without serious consequences.

blogs.sum: An anarchist journal publishing German-language revolutionary critique and English compilations. Its posts frame state, capitalist, and technological power as systems of domination and advance anarchist/revolutionary analysis, including polemics on COVID-era governance.

q.v: Es war uns eine Freude, heute das Auto von [NAME: alleged former undercover police officer] in der Nähe ihrer Winterhuder Wohnung im [STREET ADDRESS in Hamburg] anzuzünden.
q.e: It was a pleasure for us to set fire today to [NAME: alleged former undercover police officer]’s car near her Winterhude apartment on [STREET ADDRESS in Hamburg].

q.v: Andererseits, weil wir die von uns gewählte Methode erklären wollen, um sie allen zugänglich und nachahmbar zu machen.
q.e: On the other hand, because we want to explain the method we chose in order to make it accessible and replicable for everyone.

q.v: [NAME: Berlin state-security officer] from [WORKPLACE: Berlin State Criminal Police Office state-security division] lives at [HOME ADDRESS in Schönefeld], in a tranquil suburban enclave.

Mit ein bisschen Übung und etwas sicherer Internetrecherche konnten wir schnell lernen, wie man einen transportierbaren Acetylen-Sauerstoff-Schweißbrenner benutzt. Wir brachen auf das Gelände ein, auf dem die Ausrüstung gelagert ist.
q.e: With a little practice and some reliable internet research, we were quickly able to learn how to use a portable acetylene-oxygen welding torch. We broke into the site where the equipment was stored.

q.v: Wenn der Hauptsitz einer Firma schwer zu erreichen ist, können wir eines ihrer zahlreichen Fahrzeuge abfackeln, eine ihrer Zweigstellen oder ihre Stromversorgung.
q.e: If a company's headquarters is difficult to reach, we can torch one of its numerous vehicles, one of its branches, or its power supply.

blogs.sum: Catalan/Spanish-language solidarity and mobilization outlet supporting the Notre-Dame-des-Landes (NDDL) ZAD in France. It republishes police-risk information and provides detailed travel, rendezvous, equipment, communications, medical/legal-contact, and reconstruction guidance for people joining resistance to the eviction.

q.v: · Des del primer dia de l’operació, accions de bloqueig de carreteres coordinades o «operacions cargol» als punts d’accés de la zona o en grans autopistes i punts estratègics de la regió. També ocupacions de llocs de poder.
q.e: · From the first day of the operation, coordinated road-blocking actions or “snail operations” at access points to the area or on major highways and strategic points in the region. Also occupations of places of power.

q.v: Picnics a zones de defensa, bales de palla a les barricades, excavadores incendiades, tirs de pintura,…

blogs.sum: Czech anarchist-oriented publishing collective documenting and selling books on forgotten strikes and labor struggles in Czech history. Its posts connect May Day, the Haymarket martyrs, direct action, class struggle, and social revolution, primarily through historical education and movement memory.

q.v: Antimilitarismus tak říká, nemiřte na sebe zbraněmi, nevražděte se v jejich válkách, odmítněte se na nich podílet, a když vás donutí vzít zbraň, otočte je na svoje pány, původce svého neštěstí.
q.e: Antimilitarism thus says: do not aim weapons at each other, do not murder one another in their wars, refuse to take part in them, and when they force you to take up a weapon, turn it on your masters, the causes of your misfortune.

q.v: Hrdinstvím je protestovat proti válce, zastavit politiky ve vedení války: demonstracemi, generální stávkou, sabotováním válečné výroby a obchodu, odstraněním vládců od moci, vzpourou, sociální revolucí.
q.e: Heroism is to protest against war, to stop politicians from waging war: through demonstrations, a general strike, sabotaging war production and trade, removing rulers from power, rebellion, social revolution.

q.v: Proto nepodporujeme válečnou mobilizaci, ale oproti tomu podporujeme rozmanité aktivity sabotující další pokračování války.
q.e: Therefore, we do not support war mobilization; on the contrary, we support diverse activities that sabotage the further continuation of the war.

blogs.sum: A local ZAD-linked ecological resistance blog supporting the occupation of the former Schoppach sandpit near Arlon, Belgium, and opposing development, concrete construction, and the company Thomas & Piron. Posts document the eviction, gather public support, circulate solidarity messages, and call for varied actions against the named developer.

q.v: Le fait de venir s’installer directement sur la zone menacée était apparu comme le moyen le plus efficace pour bloquer concrètement la destruction permanente de tous les espaces vivants sur terre.
q.e: Coming to settle directly on the threatened site had appeared to be the most effective means of concretely blocking the permanent destruction of all living spaces on Earth.

q.v: Nous appelons à un rassemblement symbolique au potager au [STREET ADDRESS], ce potager lui aussi menacé d’être bétonné.
q.e: We call for a symbolic gathering at the vegetable garden at [STREET ADDRESS], which is also threatened with being covered in concrete.

q.v: Vincent Magnus parle d’une fin de saga, montrons lui qu’il n’est pas au bout de ses surprises, soyons nombreu.se.s en ce début de soirée. Ramenons dans le centre d’Arlon le mouvement de résistance qu’il n’ont pas tenu à rencontrer ce matin. Rappelons une fois de plus que nous sommes un mouvement large et divers, riche en couleurs et en motivation! RDV 18H PLACE LÉOPOLD A ARLON!
q.e: Vincent Magnus speaks of an end to the saga; let us show him that he has not seen the last of it—let us be numerous at the beginning of this evening. Let us bring into the centre of Arlon the resistance movement that they did not want to face this morning. Let us remind them once again that we are a broad and diverse movement, rich in colours and motivation! MEET AT 6 PM, PLACE LÉOPOLD, ARLON!

q.v: Nous appelons toutes les personnes qui n’en peuvent plus de ce monde où la solidarité, la joie, les interactions n’existent plus, à mener des actions envers cette entreprise championne de la bétonisation et de la mort du vivant à mener des actions en fonction de ses capacités. Pétition, interpellations sur les réseaux sociaux, pièces de théâtres sauvages, inondation de mails, chansons, affichage recours en justice, poèmes, blocage de chantier, tags, sabotage…
q.e: We call on all those who can no longer bear this world in which solidarity, joy, and interaction no longer exist to take action against this company—a champion of concreting over the land and of the death of living things—according to their abilities. Petitions, calling it out on social media, guerrilla theatre, flooding it with emails, songs, posters, legal action, poems, construction-site blockades, graffiti, sabotage…
